name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: A kneeling core exercise in which an ab wheel is rolled forward and pulled back with the abs.
instructions: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders; brace your abs and set your back in a neutral position.
Roll the wheel forward without arching your lower back; stay within the distance where you can keep your torso steady.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees with your abs; shorten the range or stop if you feel discomfort in your lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the ab wheel rollout, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ab Wheel ile Roll-out yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Adductor Ball Squeeze
description: A lying exercise in which a soft ball is squeezed between the knees to work the inner thigh muscles.
instructions: Lie on your back and bend your knees; place a soft pilates ball between your knees.
Exhale and squeeze the ball with your knees in a controlled way; keep your lower back and shoulders relaxed.
Release the squeeze and return to the start; apply light pressure without causing pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the adductor ball squeeze, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Adduktör Top Sıkıştırma yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Adductor Squeeze Bridge
description: A floor bridge performed while lightly squeezing a small ball between the knees.
instructions: Lie on the back with knees bent, feet planted, and a small soft ball between the knees.
Gently squeeze the ball while lifting the hips into a bridge without flaring the knees.
Lower the hips slowly while keeping the ball in place.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the start and finish of Adductor Squeeze Bridge, with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Top Sıkmalı Köprü hareketinin başlangıç ve bitişi iki gri karede gösteriliyor; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Archer Push-Up
description: A wide-handed push-up in which the body shifts toward one arm while the opposite arm extends to the side.
instructions: Place your hands wider than your shoulders and take a plank position; keep the body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend one elbow and lower your chest toward that hand while extending the opposite arm out to the side.
Push back to the center under control; work both sides equally and put your knees down if needed.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Archer Push-Up, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Okçu Şınavı hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Arnold Press
description: A seated dumbbell press that rotates the palms from facing the body to facing forward as the weights go overhead.
instructions: Sit with your hips and torso supported and your feet planted. Hold the dumbbells at shoulder height with your palms facing you and your wrists stacked over your elbows.
Press upward while gradually rotating your palms forward. Keep your torso steady without arching your lower back excessively; use a comfortable, controlled range.
Lower the dumbbells under control to shoulder height, reversing the palm rotation as you descend. If the movement causes shoulder pain, stop and choose a pain-free alternative.

alt.en: Seated Arnold Press shown at the start with palms facing the torso and at the overhead finish with palms forward; small red arrows beside the wrists indicate the outward rotation. Shoulders are highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Arnold Press'in oturarak başlangıç ve dambıllar baş üstünde bitiş pozları; başlangıçta avuç içleri gövdeye, bitişte öne dönük. Bilek yanındaki küçük kırmızı oklar dışa dönüşü gösteriyor; omuzlar kırmızı vurgulu.

name: Assisted Dip
description: A selectorized assisted-dip machine supports the knees while the athlete lowers and presses up between parallel handles.
instructions: Sit or kneel on the assist platform, hold the parallel handles, and select enough assistance to move smoothly.
Bend your elbows to lower your body within a comfortable range while keeping your torso steady.
Press through the handles to return to the top; stop if you feel shoulder pain or cannot control the descent.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Assisted Dip; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yardımlı Dip hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
description: A vertical pull-up performed on an assist machine that offsets part of the body weight.
instructions: Adjust the support of the assisted pull-up machine and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull your elbows down and lift your body up in a controlled manner.
Extend your arms slowly; do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Assisted Pull-Up, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yardımlı Barfiks hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: 45-Degree Back Extension
description: A hip-hinge back extension performed on a 45-degree bench that trains the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set the hip pad so it sits just below the pelvis; secure your feet.
Bend the torso forward from the hips, keeping the back neutral and the movement controlled.
Rise until the torso is in line with the legs; do not arch the lower back beyond that point.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the 45-Degree Back Extension, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: 45 Derece Sırt Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Band Pull-Apart
description: A light band exercise in which the arms are opened to the sides to bring the shoulder blades together.
instructions: Hold a light band at chest height with your arms in front and your elbows soft.
Open your arms to the sides while bringing your shoulder blades toward each other; do not raise your shoulders.
Slowly bring the band back to the start while keeping tension; keep your torso still.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Band Pull-Apart, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bant Pull-Apart hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Band-Resisted Lateral Neck Flexion
description: A very light band-resisted sideways neck bend performed through a small, comfortable range of motion.
instructions: Sit upright; place a very light band beside your head and tie it to a fixed point at head height.
Tilt your head sideways only through a small, comfortable range to gently resist the band; keep your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly return to the neutral position; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the band-resisted lateral neck flexion, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Yan Boyun Fleksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Band-Resisted March
description: A standing hip-flexion exercise that raises one knee against an anchored resistance band.
instructions: Anchor a resistance band low and loop it securely around one ankle; stand tall facing away from the anchor.
Brace your trunk and lift the banded knee toward hip height without leaning back.
Lower slowly against the band, then switch legs.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Band-Resisted March; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bant Dirençli Diz Çekişi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Band-Resisted Neck Extension
description: A very light band-resisted backward neck extension performed through a small range of motion.
instructions: Sit upright; place a very light band behind your head and anchor it in front of you at head height.
Bring your head back from neutral by only a few degrees to gently resist the band; do not lean back excessively.
Return to the neutral position in a controlled way; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the band-resisted neck extension, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Boyun Ekstansiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Band-Resisted Neck Flexion
description: A very light band-resisted forward neck flexion performed through a small range of motion.
instructions: Sit upright; place a very light band on your forehead and anchor it behind you at head height.
Tilt your neck forward only a few degrees to gently resist the band; keep your shoulders relaxed.
Return to the neutral position in a controlled way; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the band-resisted neck flexion, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Boyun Fleksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Banded Clamshell
description: A side-lying hip exercise in which the top knee opens against a light band to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side, bend your knees and place a light band above your knees; keep your feet stacked.
Open your top knee in a controlled way without rolling your torso and hips backward.
Slowly close the knee against the resistance of the band; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the banded clamshell, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Clamshell yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Banded Monster Walk
description: A band-resisted walk in a small squat with sideways steps that works the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Place a mini band above your knees; bend your knees slightly and squat a little from the hips.
Keeping the band tense, take a controlled step to the side; track your knees in the direction of your feet.
Do not let the band go slack as you bring the other foot closer; travel equally in both directions.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the banded monster walk, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Canavar Yürüyüşü yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description: A loaded squat with the bar supported across the upper back.
instructions: Place the bar across the upper back and set your feet at a comfortable, balanced width.
Brace the abs and send the hips down and back; keep the knees tracking over the toes.
Descend to a depth you can control and drive up through the feet to stand.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Back Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Sırt Squatı hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description: A horizontal barbell press performed while lying on a bench.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, plant your feet firmly and hold the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Set the shoulder blades into the bench and lower the bar under control to the mid-lower chest.
Keep the wrists stacked over the elbows and press the bar up; use a spotter on heavy attempts.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete pressing a barbell above a flat bench, with the chest highlighted red and an upward arrow.
alt.tr: Düz sehpada halteri yukarı iten gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla ve itiş yönü okla gösteriliyor.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Bench Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Bench Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Bulgarian Split Squat
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat loaded with a barbell across the upper back to train the front leg through a controlled single-leg squat.
instructions: Set a stable bench behind you and place the bar across your upper back, not your neck; rest the top of one foot on the bench and set the front foot far enough forward to keep the heel down.
Brace your trunk and lower mostly straight down by bending both knees; keep the front knee tracking with the toes and stop at a depth you can control.
Drive through the whole front foot to stand. Complete the repetitions on one side before switching; use a rack and a light load until balance is steady.

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a barbell Bulgarian split squat; the athlete wears opaque shorts and the front-leg quadriceps are highlighted red.
alt.tr: Halterli Bulgarian Split Squat hareketinin iki gri aşaması; sporcu kapalı şort giyiyor ve ön bacak kuadriseps kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Curl
description: An elbow flexion exercise that curls a barbell with an underhand grip to train the biceps.
instructions: Hold the bar with your palms facing forward; keep your elbows fixed at your sides.
Raise the bar toward your shoulders without moving your elbows forward.
Lower the bar under control and keep your wrists straight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Pazı Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Decline Bench Press
description: A barbell is lowered to the lower chest and pressed up while lying on a decline bench.
instructions: Secure your feet on a decline bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width; use a spotter or rack safeties.
Lower the bar under control toward the lower chest with wrists stacked over elbows.
Press the bar back above the chest without bouncing it; stop if you cannot control the path.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Barbell Decline Bench Press; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Decline Bench Press hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Drag Curl
description: An underhand curl that keeps the bar close to the torso as the elbows move back.
instructions: Stand tall with an underhand grip and the bar against the upper thighs.
Draw the bar close along the abdomen while the elbows move slightly behind the torso.
Lower the bar along the same path without swinging.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the start and finish of Barbell Drag Curl, with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Barı Gövdeye Yakın Çekerek Biceps Curl hareketinin başlangıç ve bitişi iki gri karede gösteriliyor; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Floor Press
description: A horizontal barbell press performed while lying directly on the floor, with the upper arms stopping at the floor on each repetition.
instructions: Lie on a mat with knees bent and feet flat; use a rack or a spotter to position the bar safely over mid-chest.
Lower the bar under control until your upper arms lightly touch the floor, keeping wrists above elbows.
Press the bar back over mid-chest until your arms are nearly straight; do not bounce your elbows off the floor.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the lowered and pressed positions of a Barbell Floor Press, with the chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Floor Press hareketinin indirme ve itiş pozisyonları iki gri karede gösteriliyor; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Forward Lunge
description: A forward lunge performed with a barbell held across the upper back.
instructions: Set the bar in a rack at shoulder height, position it across your upper back, and stand with feet about hip-width apart.
Step one foot forward and lower under control until both knees bend comfortably; keep the front foot planted and knee tracking with the toes.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other side. Re-rack the bar securely when finished.

alt.en: Two grayscale phases show a barbell forward lunge; loose opaque shorts fully cover the hips and groin and the quadriceps and glutes are highlighted red.
alt.tr: Halterle İleri Hamle hareketinin iki gri aşaması; kalça ve kasık bol, opak şortla tamamen kapalı, quadriceps ve kalçalar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
description: A loaded hip-extension exercise performed from the floor with a barbell across the hips.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat; place a padded barbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Brace your trunk and drive through your feet to lift your hips until your torso and thighs align.
Lower your hips under control without arching your lower back.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Barbell Glute Bridge; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterli Glute Bridge hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: A hip extension movement performed with the upper back on a bench and a loaded barbell across the hips.
instructions: Rest the upper back on a bench and place the bar in the crease of the hips; use a pad for comfort.
Plant the feet on the floor and lift the hips upward while keeping the ribs down.
Squeeze the glutes when the torso is parallel to the floor; lower under control without over-arching the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Hip Thrust, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Hip Thrust hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Push Press
description: An overhead barbell press that uses a shallow leg dip and drive to help move the bar from the shoulders to overhead.
instructions: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and the bar resting across the front shoulders; hold it just outside shoulder width with elbows slightly forward.
Keep your torso upright as you make a short vertical dip by bending your knees, then drive through your feet and press the bar overhead in one smooth motion.
Finish with the elbows straight and the bar balanced over your midfoot; keep your legs straight after the bar leaves the shoulders, then lower it under control to the front rack.

source.title: CrossFit Level 1 Training Guide — Push Press

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a barbell push press, from the front-rack dip to overhead lockout; shoulders and triceps are highlighted red and loose opaque shorts cover the hips and groin.
alt.tr: Halterle Push Press hareketinin ön omuzlardaki dip ve baş üstünde kilitleme aşamaları; omuz ve arka kol kırmızıyla vurgulanmış, kalça ve kasık bol opak şortla örtülmüş.

name: Barbell Reverse Curl
description: A straight-bar curl with a pronated grip that emphasizes the forearms and brachioradialis.
instructions: Hold a straight bar about shoulder-width with your palms down, wrists straight, and elbows close to your sides.
Keeping your upper arms still, curl the bar toward your shoulders without swinging your torso.
Lower the bar slowly to the start position; use a manageable load and keep your wrists neutral.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas exercise guide based on ACE Reverse Bicep Curl

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a standing overhand barbell curl with the forearms highlighted red; the athlete wears opaque shorts.
alt.tr: Üstten tutuşla ayakta barbell curl hareketinin iki gri aşaması; ön kollar kırmızıyla vurgulanır ve sporcu opak şort giyer.

name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
description: A barbell is held across the upper back while alternating backward lunges are performed.
instructions: Set the bar securely across your upper back and stand with feet about hip-width apart.
Step one foot backward and lower under control, keeping the front foot planted and the front knee aligned with the toes.
Push through the front foot to return to standing; complete the repetitions on one side, then switch.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Barbell Reverse Lunge; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Geri Lunge hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
description: A seated wrist-extension exercise with the forearms supported and a barbell held palms-down.
instructions: Sit with your forearms supported on your thighs or a bench and hold a light barbell with palms facing down.
Keeping your forearms still, lift the backs of your hands by extending your wrists.
Lower your wrists slowly to a comfortable range; use a light load and avoid bouncing.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a barbell reverse wrist curl, forearm extensors highlighted red.
alt.tr: Halterle Ters Bilek Curl hareketinin iki gri aşaması; ön kol ekstansörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Shrug
description: A standing shrug that raises the shoulders toward the ears while holding a barbell in front of the thighs.
instructions: Hold the bar in front of your thighs with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears; do not roll them in circles.
Pause briefly at the top and slowly lower your shoulders back to the start.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Shrug, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Shrug Behind The Back
description: A standing shrug with the barbell held behind the body, raising the shoulders straight up.
instructions: Hold a light bar behind you with your arms straight and your palms facing backward.
Raise your shoulders straight up; do not bend your elbows or roll your shoulders in circles.
Pause briefly and slowly lower your shoulders; make sure the bar does not hit your legs.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Shrug Behind The Back, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Arkadan Halterle Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Walking Lunge
description: A barbell is held across the upper back while alternating forward lunges travel across the floor.
instructions: Set the bar securely across your upper back and stand with feet about hip-width apart.
Step forward and bend both knees to lower under control; keep the front knee tracking in line with the foot.
Push through the front foot to rise and bring the rear leg through into the next step; use a clear, open path.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Barbell Walking Lunge; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Yürüyüş Lunge hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Wrist Curl
description: A seated wrist-flexion exercise with the forearms supported and a barbell held palms-up.
instructions: Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up, with wrists just beyond your knees.
Let the bar roll toward your fingers, then curl your wrists upward without lifting your forearms.
Lower slowly to a comfortable stretch and repeat with a light, controlled load.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Barbell Wrist Curl; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Bilek Curl hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Battle Rope Alternating Waves
description: Alternating arm lifts send continuous waves down two anchored battle ropes.
instructions: Stand facing the anchor with feet stable and hold one rope end in each hand.
Alternate raising and lowering your arms to send waves toward the anchor at a steady rhythm.
Keep your torso braced and knees soft; use short intervals and stop if your form breaks down.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Battle Rope Alternating Waves; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Savaş Halatında Alternatif Dalgalar hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Battle Rope Double-Arm Slam
description: Both rope ends are raised overhead and driven down together to create a forceful wave.
instructions: Face the anchor in a stable stance and hold one rope end in each hand.
Raise both hands overhead, then drive them down together while bending your hips and knees slightly.
Return to the ready position under control; keep the ropes in your hands and repeat smoothly.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Battle Rope Double-Arm Slam; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Savaş Halatında Çift Kol Slam hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
description: A single-arm cable curl performed with the cable behind the body to keep tension on the biceps in the stretched position.
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley; step slightly forward so the cable stays behind you.
Keeping your elbow fixed slightly behind your torso, curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Extend your arm slowly; if you feel tension or pain in the shoulder, change the starting position.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Bayesian Cable Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bayesian Kablo Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bear Crawl
description: A crawling conditioning drill performed with the knees held just off the floor.
instructions: Start on hands and toes with knees hovering just above the mat; keep your back level and trunk braced.
Move one hand and the opposite foot forward a short distance, keeping your hips low.
Alternate sides in a slow crawl without rocking your hips; pause if your form breaks down.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Bear Crawl; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ayı Sürünüşü hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bear-Plank Shoulder Tap
description: A quadruped hover with alternating hand taps that trains trunk control.
instructions: Start on hands and knees, then hover knees just above the mat with back level.
Shift slightly and tap one hand to the opposite shoulder without rocking hips.
Replace the hand, steady yourself and alternate sides.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bear-Plank Shoulder Tap with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ayı Plankte Omuz Dokunuşu hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Wrist Curl
description: A wrist flexion exercise performed with a light barbell held behind the body to train the forearm flexors.
instructions: Hold a light bar behind you with your arms extended comfortably and your palms facing backward.
Keeping your shoulders still, raise the bar by curling your wrists in a controlled way.
Lower your wrists slowly back to the start; stop if you feel pain or numbness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Behind-the-Back Barbell Wrist Curl, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Sırt Arkasında Halterle Bilek Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Belt Squat
description: A squat performed on a platform with resistance attached to a belt around the hips.
instructions: Stand on the platform, attach the belt securely at the hip crease, and hold the machine handles for balance.
Bend your hips and knees to squat under control, keeping your torso upright and knees tracking with your toes.
Drive through the platform to stand; follow the machine placard to engage its lock before stepping off.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a belt squat machine movement, quadriceps and glutes highlighted red.
alt.tr: Belt Squat hareketinin iki gri aşaması; ön uyluk ve kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bench Dip
description: A bodyweight elbow extension movement with the hands supported behind the body.
instructions: Place hands behind the hips on a stable bench.
Bend the elbows to lower only through a comfortable range without forcing the shoulders far behind the torso; press back up and stop if you feel shoulder pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing a bench dip, triceps highlighted red.
alt.tr: Sehpada dips yapan gri tonlu sporcu; triseps kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bench Lat Stretch
description: A kneeling mobility stretch that lengthens the lats with the forearms supported on a bench.
instructions: Kneel in front of a sturdy bench and place your forearms on it around shoulder width.
Keep your head aligned with your torso, send your hips back, and lower your chest gently toward the floor.
Breathe into the stretch along your sides, then return upright without forcing your shoulders.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Bench Lat Stretch; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bench Destekli Kanat Esnetmesi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bent-Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly
description: A hip-hinged raise of light dumbbells to emphasize the rear shoulders.
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a steady back and let light dumbbells hang below the shoulders.
Lift both arms outward with softly bent elbows until near shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging the torso.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the start and finish of Bent-Over Dumbbell Reverse Fly, with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Öne Eğilerek Dambıl Ters Açış hareketinin başlangıç ve bitişi iki gri karede gösteriliyor; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
description: A barbell row performed while holding a stable hip hinge.
instructions: Grip the bar overhand and hinge at the hips; keep the back neutral and hold the torso angle.
Drive the elbows back and row the bar toward the lower ribs.
Lower the bar under control; reduce the load if the lower back starts to round.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Bent-Over Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Eğilerek Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: A floor abdominal exercise in which opposite elbow and knee are brought together in an alternating pedaling motion.
instructions: Lie on your back, bend your knees and lightly place your hands beside your head.
Rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee in a controlled way while extending the other leg; keep your lower back comfortably on the floor.
Alternate sides as if pedaling; work slowly and in control without pulling your neck with your hands.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the bicycle crunch, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bisiklet Crunch yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bird Dog
description: A quadruped exercise in which the opposite arm and leg are extended while the spine stays neutral.
instructions: Place your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips; keep your back neutral.
Extend the opposite arm and leg without rotating the torso and hold your balance briefly.
Return to the start under control and switch sides; do not let your lower back sag.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Bird Dog, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bird Dog hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bird-Dog Dumbbell Row
description: A supported one-arm dumbbell row from a three-point stance with the opposite leg extended.
instructions: Set one hand and the opposite knee on a stable bench; extend the other leg behind.
Hold a light dumbbell and row it toward your ribs while keeping your torso level.
Lower slowly, complete the side, then switch.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bird-Dog Dumbbell Row with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bird Dog Dambıl Row hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Box Jump
description: A plyometric jump onto a stable low box followed by a controlled step down.
instructions: Face a low stable box with clear space around it.
Jump softly onto the box, landing with both feet and knees bent.
Stand fully and step down one foot at a time; use a lower box if unstable.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Box Jump with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Kutuya Sıçrama hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Crab Reach
description: A crab-tabletop mobility movement reaching one arm overhead while rotating through the upper back.
instructions: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat; lift your hips into a stable crab tabletop.
Keep your head neutral and reach one arm overhead as you rotate through the upper back.
Return the hand to the floor, lower with control and alternate sides.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Crab Reach with target areas highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Crab Reach hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef bölgeler kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Curtsy Lunge
description: A reverse-lunge variation stepping diagonally behind the other leg.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other and bend both knees comfortably.
Press through the front foot to stand and switch sides.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Curtsy Lunge with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Çapraz Geri Hamle hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Inchworm
description: A bodyweight movement walking the hands from a forward fold into a high plank and back.
instructions: Stand tall, hinge at the hips and place your hands on the floor in front of your feet.
Walk your hands forward until you reach a stable high plank.
Walk your hands back and stand without forcing a hamstring stretch.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Inchworm with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Inchworm hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Jumping Jack
description: A rhythmic cardio movement jumping the feet apart as the arms rise overhead.
instructions: Stand with feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump the feet apart while raising both arms overhead.
Jump back to the starting stance and land softly; step out instead to reduce impact.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Jumping Jack with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Jumping Jack hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Lateral Bound
description: A side-to-side single-leg bound landing softly on the opposite leg.
instructions: Balance on one leg with the knee slightly bent.
Push sideways and land on the opposite leg with a soft knee.
Pause to regain balance before bounding back; shorten the distance if needed.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale lateral bound showing glutes and quadriceps of the working leg in red.
alt.tr: Yana sıçramanın iki aşamalı gri çizimi; çalışan bacağın kalça ve ön uyluk kasları kırmızı.

name: Bodyweight Mountain Climber
description: A plank-based alternating knee drive that challenges the hip flexors and trunk.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and body straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest while keeping hips low and stable.
Return the foot and switch sides at a controlled pace.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Mountain Climber with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Dağ Tırmanışı hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Plank Jack
description: A high-plank variation hopping the feet apart and together while resisting trunk movement.
instructions: Set a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet together.
Hop both feet outward while keeping your torso steady and hips level.
Hop the feet together softly; step instead if needed.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Plank Jack with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Plank Jack hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Plank to Downward Dog
description: A controlled transition from a high plank into an inverted V position.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders and feet hip-width apart.
Push the floor away and lift your hips back into an inverted V; bend knees softly if needed.
Return to plank without letting your lower back sag.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Plank to Downward Dog with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Planktan Aşağı Bakan Köpeğe Geçiş hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Side-Plank Hip Dip
description: A side-plank variation lowering and raising the hips through a controlled lateral trunk bend.
instructions: Set a forearm side plank with your elbow below your shoulder and feet stacked.
Lower your hip a short distance without rolling your chest forward.
Lift your hip back into line and repeat; switch sides.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Side-Plank Hip Dip with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Plankta Kalça İndirme hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Skater Squat
description: A single-leg squat with the free leg reaching behind and the rear knee lowering toward the floor.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent behind you.
Bend the standing knee and send the free knee toward the floor behind your body.
Press through the standing foot to rise; hold a support if balance is limited.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Skater Squat with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Skater Squat hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: A squat performed without external load, using the hips and knees to lower and rise.
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder width apart.
Bend the knees and hips, then stand back up.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing a bodyweight squat, quadriceps and glutes highlighted red.
alt.tr: Vücut ağırlığıyla squat yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön bacak ve kalça kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Squat Jump
description: A squat followed by a vertical jump and a soft, balanced landing.
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and sit into a comfortable squat.
Drive through both feet to jump vertically, using your arms naturally for balance.
Land softly with knees tracking over toes, then reset before repeating.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Squat Jump with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Squat Sıçrama hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Squat Thrust
description: A conditioning movement moving the feet from a low squat to a high plank and back.
instructions: Crouch and place both hands on the floor beneath your shoulders.
Step or hop both feet back into a stable high plank without letting the lower back sag.
Bring the feet back beneath you and stand; step one foot at a time to reduce impact.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Bodyweight Squat Thrust with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Squat Thrust hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
description: A bodyweight elbow extension performed by leaning back from a fixed bar and lowering the forehead toward it to train the triceps.
instructions: Grip a sturdy, non-slip bar at shoulder width; keep your torso straight and lean backward.
Keeping your elbows forward and fixed, bend your arms enough to bring your forehead close to the bar.
Use your triceps to extend your elbows and return to the start; adjust your foot position to change the difficulty.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Bodyweight Triceps Extension, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Arka Kol Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot raised on a low, stable bench.
instructions: Place the rear foot on a low, stable bench and set the front foot at a balanced distance.
Keep the torso balanced, bend both knees and lower to a depth you can control.
Drive up through the front foot; work both sides and take support if needed.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale Bulgarian split squat with front-leg glutes and quadriceps highlighted red.
alt.tr: Bulgar split squat'ın iki aşamalı gri çizimi; öndeki bacağın kalça ve ön uyluk kasları kırmızı.

name: Burpee
description: A bodyweight conditioning sequence that moves from standing through a plank and back to standing.
instructions: Stand with feet about hip-width apart, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Step or hop both feet back to a firm high plank while keeping your trunk braced.
Bring your feet forward and stand; add a small jump only if you can land quietly, or step to reduce impact.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Burpee; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Burpee hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Butterfly Stretch
description: A seated mobility stretch for the inner thighs with the soles of the feet together.
instructions: Sit tall on a mat, bring the soles of your feet together, and let your knees relax outward.
Keeping your spine long, hinge forward slightly from the hips until you feel a gentle inner-thigh stretch.
Breathe comfortably, avoid pressing your knees down, and return upright.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Butterfly Stretch; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kelebek Esnetmesi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Biceps Curl
description: An elbow-flexion curl using a low cable for steady resistance.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand with palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the bar toward your chest.
Lower slowly until your elbows are nearly straight; avoid swinging.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Cable Biceps Curl with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kabloyla Biceps Curl hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Crossover
description: A standing cable movement in which the arms sweep forward and down to bring the hands together in front of the body.
instructions: Attach handles to two high pulleys and stand balanced in the middle; lean your torso slightly forward.
Keeping your elbows soft, bring your arms together forward and downward.
Open your arms to the sides under control; stay in a comfortable stretch range without swinging the weight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Crossover, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Crossover hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Crunch
description: A kneeling abdominal exercise in which the torso curls forward against the resistance of a high cable.
instructions: Attach the rope to the high pulley and kneel down; hold the rope at the sides of your head.
Keeping your hips as still as possible, brace your abs and curl your torso forward in a controlled way.
Return to the start without swinging the cable; do not pull your neck with your hands.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the cable crunch, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Crunch yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
description: A cable hip extension in which the leg is driven backward against a low pulley with an ankle cuff.
instructions: Attach the ankle cuff to the low pulley and take support from a stable point.
Keep the knee slightly bent and extend the leg backward from the hip; hold the torso and lower back still.
Slowly bring the leg back to the start; work both sides without arching the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Glute Kickback, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Glute Kickback hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
description: A standing hip exercise in which the working leg is pulled out to the side against a low cable.
instructions: Attach the ankle cuff to the low cable and stand balanced next to the machine.
Keeping your torso still, open the working leg out to the side in a controlled way.
Return the leg to the starting position without swinging it; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing cable hip abduction; the outer hip of the moving leg is highlighted red and an arrow shows the outward movement.
alt.tr: Kablo ile kalça abdüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; hareket eden bacağın dış kalçası kırmızıyla vurgulanmış ve ok dışa hareketi gösteriyor.

media.creator: Open Exercise Atlas (AI-assisted edit of Monk Mode illustration)

name: Cable Hip Adduction
description: A standing hip exercise in which the working leg is pulled inward across the body against a low cable.
instructions: Attach the ankle strap to the low pulley; stand sideways to the machine and hold on for support.
Pull the working leg inward in front of your body in a controlled way; do not rotate your hips.
Return to the start against the resistance; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the cable hip adduction, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo ile Kalça Addüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Oblique Crunch
description: A standing cable trunk-flexion exercise performed toward one side to emphasize the obliques.
instructions: Set a high cable attachment and stand side-on to the machine; hold the handle near your upper chest with a comfortable stance.
Brace your trunk and bend sideways toward the cable in a short, controlled range while keeping your hips steady.
Return slowly against the cable and complete both sides; keep your head relaxed and do not pull on your neck.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Cable Oblique Crunch; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablolu Oblik Crunch hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Pull-Through
description: A cable hip hinge in which the rope is pulled through the legs from a low pulley.
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley, face away from the cable and hold the rope between the legs.
Bend the knees slightly and send the hips back while keeping the back neutral.
Stand tall by bringing the hips forward; repeat with control without pushing the lower back backward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Pull-Through, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Pull-Through hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
description: A cable fly in which the arms open out to the sides to train the rear deltoids.
instructions: Attach handles to two low pulleys and stand in front of the cables; grip the handles with crossed hands.
Keeping your elbows slightly bent, open your arms out to the sides; keep your torso still.
Bring your arms back to the crossed start position under control; do not swing the weight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Rear Delt Fly, rear deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Arka Omuz Fly hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Reverse Curl
description: An overhand cable curl that trains the forearms and elbow flexors while the upper arms stay close to the torso.
instructions: Attach a short straight bar to a low pulley. Stand facing the stack, hold the bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip, and keep your wrists straight.
Keeping your upper arms beside your torso, bend your elbows and curl the bar toward your lower chest without swinging your body.
Lower the bar slowly until your elbows are nearly straight, maintaining the overhand grip and steady cable tension.

source.title: ACE Reverse Bicep Curl exercise guidance

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a low-cable reverse curl with a straight bar; forearms are highlighted red and loose opaque shorts cover the hips and groin.
alt.tr: Düz barla alçak makarada ters curl hareketinin iki gri aşaması; ön kollar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış, kalça ve kasık bol opak şortla örtülmüş.

name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip hinge performed facing a low cable pulley with the handle travelling close along the front of the legs.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the low pulley and face the stack. Hold the bar against the front of your thighs with feet hip-width apart and knees softly bent.
Push your hips backward and hinge forward while keeping your spine long and the bar close to your legs; lower until you feel a comfortable hamstring stretch.
Press through your feet and extend your hips to stand. Keep the knees softly bent, avoid rounding your back, and do not lean backward at the top.

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a cable Romanian deadlift performed facing the low pulley; the athlete wears opaque shorts and the hamstrings are highlighted red.
alt.tr: Alçak makaraya dönük yapılan kabloda Romanian Deadlift hareketinin iki gri aşaması; sporcu kapalı şort giyiyor ve hamstringler kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
description: A neutral-grip curl performed with the ends of a rope attached to a low cable pulley.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold one end in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the rope toward your lower chest without swinging your torso.
Lower the rope slowly until your elbows are extended; keep your wrists neutral.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the lowered and curled positions of a standing cable rope hammer curl, with biceps highlighted red.
alt.tr: Ayakta Kablo Halat Hammer Curl hareketinin indirme ve çekme pozisyonları iki gri karede gösteriliyor; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Rope Triceps Pushdown
description: A high-cable elbow-extension exercise using a rope attachment that lets the hands separate slightly at the bottom.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand close enough to keep the cable taut. Hold one end in each hand with elbows bent and tucked beside your torso.
Keep your upper arms still and extend your elbows, pressing the rope down. Near the bottom, let your hands move slightly apart without swinging your shoulders forward.
Bend your elbows slowly to return the rope to the start while keeping your torso steady.

alt.en: Two phases of a cable rope triceps pushdown, with elbows tucked and rope ends slightly separated at extension; triceps highlighted red and loose opaque shorts covering the hips and groin.
alt.tr: Halatla kablo arka kol itişinin iki aşaması; dirsekler gövde yanında, kollar açılırken halat uçları hafif ayrılmış, arka kol kırmızıyla vurgulanmış ve kalça-kasık bol opak şortla örtülmüş.

name: Cable Shrug
description: A standing shoulder-elevation exercise performed while holding a low cable bar.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and stand tall holding it in front of your thighs.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears without bending your elbows or rolling your shoulders.
Lower your shoulders slowly while keeping the cable under control.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Cable Shrug; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kabloda Omuz Silkme hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Triceps Kickback
description: A one-arm cable elbow extension performed from a hinged position with the upper arm held beside the torso.
instructions: Set a single handle to a low pulley. Hinge slightly and brace your free hand on your thigh; keep the working upper arm beside your torso.
Straighten your elbow to move the handle back until the arm is nearly straight; keep the shoulder and upper arm still.
Bend your elbow slowly to return, then complete the same number of repetitions on the other side.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a one-arm cable triceps kickback, triceps highlighted red.
alt.tr: Tek kollu Kablo Arka Kol Kickback hareketinin iki gri aşaması; arka kol kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Woodchop
description: A standing rotational exercise in which a cable is pulled diagonally downward across the body with the torso.
instructions: Set the cable above head height and grip the handle with both hands; set your feet balanced.
Keeping your arms slightly bent, rotate your torso diagonally downward in a controlled way; keep your hips still.
Return to the start slowly; do not swing the movement from your lower back and work both sides equally.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the cable woodchop, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Woodchop yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
description: A wrist curl with the palms facing up and a short bar on a low cable pulley to train the forearm flexors.
instructions: Attach a short bar to a low pulley; support your forearms on your thighs and turn your palms up.
Without moving your forearms, raise the bar slightly by bending your wrists.
Lower the bar under control; stop the movement if you feel wrist pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Wrist Curl, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Bilek Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Wrist Extension
description: A wrist extension with the palms facing down and a short bar on a low cable pulley to train the forearm extensors.
instructions: Attach a short bar to a low pulley; support your forearms on your thighs and turn your palms down.
With your forearms still, extend your wrists backward.
Lower the bar slowly; work within a small, pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Wrist Extension, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Bilek Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Y Raise
description: A light cable raise in which the arms are lifted up and out in a Y shape to train the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold the two low cables crossed; start with your arms slightly bent in front of your torso.
Raise your arms up and out under control to form a Y shape; keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Lower the weights slowly to the start; use a light load and do not lean back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Y Raise, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Y Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: An ankle extension movement performed by rising onto the balls of the feet.
instructions: Place the balls of the feet on a low, stable step and hold a support for balance.
Lower the heels through a comfortable range of motion.
Rise up onto the toes, pause briefly at the top and lower slowly.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Standing Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ayakta Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
description: A forearm-supported knee raise is performed on a vertical captain’s chair station without swinging.
instructions: Rest your forearms on the pads and your back against the support; let your legs hang without swinging.
Brace your abdomen and draw both bent knees toward your torso in a controlled lift.
Lower your legs slowly to the start; shorten the range if you need to swing or feel discomfort.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Captain's Chair Knee Raise; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Captain’s Chair Diz Çekişi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cat-Cow
description: A gentle all-fours spinal mobility sequence between rounded and extended positions.
instructions: Start on hands and knees with wrists below shoulders and knees below hips.
Gently round the spine and let the head follow without forcing the neck.
Slowly move into a comfortable, mild spinal extension, then return; avoid pushing into pain.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the start and finish of Cat-Cow, with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kedi-İnek Mobilitesi hareketinin başlangıç ve bitişi iki gri karede gösteriliyor; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Chest Dip
description: A parallel-bar dip with a slight forward torso lean to emphasize the chest.
instructions: Support yourself on sturdy parallel bars with elbows straight and shoulders comfortable.
Lean slightly forward and bend the elbows, lowering only through a pain-free range.
Press back to support without shrugging; use an assisted machine if needed.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Chest Dip with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: Göğüs Dip hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
description: A dumbbell row performed lying face down on an incline bench so the chest supports the torso.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench and hold the dumbbells with your arms hanging down.
Keeping your chest on the bench, pull your elbows back and bring the dumbbells toward your ribs.
Extend your arms under control without letting your shoulders drop forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Göğüs Destekli Dambıl Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Shrug
description: A shrug performed face down on an incline bench so the chest supports the torso.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench and hold light dumbbells with your arms hanging down.
Without bending your elbows, raise your shoulders toward your ears under control.
Pause briefly and slowly lower your shoulders; do not strain your neck and do not swing the dumbbells.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Chest-Supported Dumbbell Shrug, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Göğüs Destekli Dambıl Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
description: A plate-loaded T-bar row with the torso supported on an angled chest pad.
instructions: Adjust the chest pad so you can reach the handles with your chest supported and feet planted.
Pull the handles toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back while keeping your chest on the pad.
Extend your arms slowly to return; do not let the plates drop or your torso lift from the pad.

name: Child's Pose
description: A kneeling mobility position that gently lengthens the back and hips.
instructions: Start on hands and knees on a mat with hands comfortably forward.
Gently shift your hips toward your heels and reach your arms ahead until you feel an easy stretch through your back.
Breathe slowly, return to hands and knees, and stay within a comfortable range.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Child's Pose; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çocuk Pozu hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Chin Tuck
description: A small seated head-retraction movement that gently works the deep neck flexors.
instructions: Sit upright and look straight ahead; relax your shoulders and keep your head neutral.
Without tilting your chin down, slide your head straight back in a line; make a small double-chin movement.
Hold briefly and release; repeat without forcing the movement and stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the chin tuck, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çene İçe Alma (Chin Tuck) yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Chin-Up
description: A vertical bodyweight pull using an underhand grip on a secure bar.
instructions: Hang from a sturdy bar with palms facing you at shoulder width and shoulders away from the ears.
Pull the elbows down to bring the chin toward bar level; do not swing the legs.
Lower under control by extending the arms; shorten the rep if you feel shoulder pain or lose control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Chin-Up, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Tutuş Barfiks hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: A barbell bench press with a shoulder-width grip to emphasize elbow extension.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar around shoulder width; stack wrists over elbows.
Unrack the bar and lower it toward the lower chest with elbows near your sides.
Press without bouncing the bar; use a spotter for heavy sets.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Close-Grip Bench Press with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dar Tutuş Bench Press hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown
description: A cable pulldown with a close neutral-grip V handle that brings the handle to the upper chest.
instructions: Attach a close-grip V bar to the high pulley; secure the thigh pad and grip the handle.
Keeping your torso upright, pull your elbows down and close to your body; bring the bar to your upper chest.
Extend your arms under control; do not pull the bar behind your neck and do not swing your torso.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dar Tutuşla Önden Lat Çekiş hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Close-Grip Machine Chest Press
description: A seated machine chest press using close handles to emphasize elbow extension while training the chest.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the close-grip handles begin near mid-chest; plant your feet and keep your back on the pad.
Press the handles forward with elbows close to your sides, stopping before locking them.
Let the handles return slowly until your elbows bend comfortably; keep your shoulders from rolling forward.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a close-grip machine chest press, chest and triceps highlighted red.
alt.tr: Makinede dar tutuş göğüs presinin iki gri aşaması; göğüs ve arka kol kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
description: A push-up with the hands placed at shoulder width or closer and the elbows kept near the torso to emphasize the triceps.
instructions: Get into a plank position with your hands at shoulder width or slightly narrower; keep your body straight.
Keeping your elbows close to your torso, lower your chest toward the floor under control.
Push the floor away to return to the start; if needed, put your knees on the floor and keep your wrists in a pain-free position.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Close-Grip Push-Up, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dar Tutuşlu Şınav hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Concentration Curl
description: A seated single-arm dumbbell curl with the elbow braced against the inner thigh to isolate the biceps.
instructions: Sit with your legs comfortably apart; rest the elbow of your working arm on the inside of the thigh on the same side.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder while keeping your upper arm and torso still.
Lower the weight under control and switch sides; keep your wrist straight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Concentration Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Konsantrasyon Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Conventional Deadlift
description: A barbell lift from the floor that combines leg drive and hip extension.
instructions: Bring the bar over midfoot, hinge at the hips to grip it and keep a neutral spine.
Brace the abs and lift the bar close to the legs, extending hips and knees together.
Lower the bar along the same line under control; if the back rounds, reduce the load or get coaching.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Conventional Deadlift, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Klasik Deadlift hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cossack Squat
description: A wide-stance lateral squat in which the body shifts onto one bent leg while the other leg stays straight.
instructions: Set your feet wide apart; if needed, lightly hold a stable support for balance.
Send your hips to one side and bend that knee; keep the other leg comfortably straight.
Push through your foot to return to the center and move to the other side; stay in a pain-free, controllable depth.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the cossack squat, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kosak Squat yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cross-Body Cable Triceps Extension
description: A single-arm high-cable triceps extension in which the forearm is extended down and across the body.
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and grip it with your working hand; keep your elbow at your side.
Extend your forearm under control across your body and downward.
Return to the start with your elbow fixed; do not rotate your shoulder, and stop if you feel pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cross-Body Cable Triceps Extension, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çapraz Kablo Arka Kol Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
description: A hammer curl in which the dumbbell is raised across the torso toward the opposite shoulder to train the biceps and brachialis.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other; keep your elbows fixed at your sides.
Raise one dumbbell across the front of your torso toward the opposite shoulder; do not rotate your wrist.
Lower the weight under control and repeat with the other arm; do not round your shoulder forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cross-Body Hammer Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çapraz Çekiç Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cuban Press
description: A light dumbbell exercise that rotates the forearms upward from an elbow-bent position at shoulder height to train the rotator cuff and deltoids.
instructions: Hold very light dumbbells and bend your elbows at shoulder height; spread your upper arms out to the sides.
Keeping the elbow angle, slowly rotate your forearms upward; progress only within a comfortable range.
Return to the start under control; use a very light load in this movement and stop if your shoulder is uncomfortable.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cuban Press, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Cuban Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cyclist Squat
description: A narrow-stance squat with the heels raised on a low surface to bias the front of the thighs.
instructions: Place the heels on a low, stable raised surface and set the feet in a narrow, balanced stance.
Keeping the torso upright, squat to a comfortable depth while the knees track in line with the toes.
Push through the soles of the feet to stand up under control; reduce the depth if you feel knee pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cyclist Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bisikletçi Squatı hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dead Bug
description: A supine alternating arm-and-leg reach that challenges trunk control.
instructions: Lie on the back with arms above the shoulders and hips and knees bent to about 90 degrees.
Extend one arm overhead and the opposite leg toward the floor while keeping the trunk steady.
Return to tabletop, then switch sides without rushing.
