alt.tr: Ölü Böcek hareketinin başlangıç ve bitişi iki gri karede gösteriliyor; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dead Hang
description: A grip-endurance hold hanging from a secure pull-up bar with straight arms.
instructions: Grip a secure pull-up bar with hands about shoulder-width apart and feet off the floor.
Hang with straight elbows and breathe steadily; keep the shoulders comfortable.
Step down safely before your grip gives out.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Dead Hang with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Barfiks Demirinde Asılı Kalma hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
description: A dumbbell press performed on a declined bench that emphasizes the lower chest.
instructions: Secure your feet safely on the declined bench and hold the dumbbells at the lower sides of your chest.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest under control; keep your wrists above your elbows.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest; get help to put them down if needed.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Decline Dumbbell Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Alt Eğimli Dambıl Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Decline Push-Up
description: A push-up with the feet elevated on a bench, shifting more load toward the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place your feet on a sturdy bench and your hands on the floor at shoulder width; keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows under control and bring your chest toward the floor.
Push the floor away and return to the start; if your lower back sags, choose a lower elevation.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Decline Push-Up, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ayakları Yükseltilmiş Şınav hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Decline Sit-Up
description: A sit-up performed on a decline bench with the feet anchored to increase the range and load on the abs.
instructions: Secure your feet safely to the decline bench; cross your arms over your chest.
Brace your abs and raise your torso toward your knees; do not pull your neck with your hands.
Lower your torso to the bench in a controlled way; do not work at a depth that strains your lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the decline sit-up, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Sehpada Mekik yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Deficit Deadlift
description: A barbell deadlift performed while standing on a low, stable platform to increase the range of motion.
instructions: Stand on a low, stable platform with the bar over mid-foot; hinge down and grip the bar with a neutral spine.
Brace and lift the bar close to the legs by extending the knees and hips together.
Lower the bar under control; use a light load and reduce the platform height if you cannot keep your back position.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale deficit deadlift showing glutes, thighs and a narrow lower-back strip in red.
alt.tr: Yükseltilmiş zeminde deadlift'in iki aşamalı gri çizimi; kalça, bacaklar ve ince bir bel şeridi kırmızı.

name: Deficit Push-Up
description: A push-up performed on handles so the chest can lower slightly below hand level.
instructions: Place sturdy push-up handles at shoulder width and take a plank position.
Bend your elbows under control and lower your chest slightly below the level of your hands; keep your body straight.
Push up from a depth that is pain-free and that you can control; if you feel discomfort in your shoulders, shorten the range of motion.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Deficit Push-Up, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tutaçlı Derin Şınav hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Donkey Calf Raises
description: A calf raise performed bent forward at the hips with the toes on a raised surface and the hands on a support.
instructions: Place the toes on a stable raised surface and support yourself with the hands on a sturdy bench; hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the heels within a comfortable range, then rise up onto the toes.
Pause briefly at the top and lower slowly; do not bounce or let go of the balance support.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Donkey Calf Raises, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eşek Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Donkey Kick
description: A bodyweight hip extension performed on hands and knees by lifting one bent leg toward the ceiling.
instructions: Get on your hands and knees; stabilise the torso and keep the neck neutral.
Keeping one knee bent, lift the foot toward the ceiling without arching the lower back.
Bring the knee back toward the floor under control and switch sides; keep the hip movement small and balanced.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Donkey Kick, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eşek Tekmesi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A horizontal press using a dumbbell in each hand while lying on a bench.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower the weights beside the chest and press upward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing a flat dumbbell bench press, chest highlighted red.
alt.tr: Düz sehpada dambıl bench press yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
description: A hip-hinged row pulls two dumbbells from below the shoulders toward the lower ribs.
instructions: Hinge forward with a dumbbell in each hand and let the arms hang beneath your shoulders.
Keeping your back neutral, row both weights toward your lower ribs with elbows close to your sides.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the start without rounding your back.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Bent-Over Row; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Eğilerek Row hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
description: An elbow flexion movement with a dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at the sides with elbows near the torso.
Bend the elbows to raise the weights and lower slowly.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing a standing dumbbell biceps curl, biceps highlighted red.
alt.tr: Ayakta dambıl biseps curl yapan gri tonlu sporcu; biseps kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat
description: A loaded split squat with the rear foot elevated on a bench and dumbbells held at the sides.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, stand in a split stance, and rest the rear foot on a stable bench.
Bend both knees to lower under control, keeping most of your weight through the front foot and the front knee aligned with your toes.
Press through the front foot to stand; complete one side, then switch.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Bulgarian Split Squat; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıllı Bulgarian Split Squat hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Deadlift
description: A conventional floor-start deadlift holding one dumbbell in each hand, using coordinated hip and knee extension to stand.
instructions: Stand hip-width with one dumbbell outside each foot. Hinge and bend the knees to grasp the handles, brace your trunk, and keep your back neutral.
Push through the floor and extend your hips and knees together, keeping the dumbbells close to your legs as you stand.
Send your hips back and bend your knees to lower both dumbbells under control beside your feet; reset your brace before the next repetition.

alt.en: Floor-start and standing phases of a dumbbell deadlift with one dumbbell in each hand; glutes and hamstrings highlighted red, loose opaque shorts covering the hips and groin.
alt.tr: Her elde bir dambılla yerden başlanan ve doğrulunan dambıllı deadlift aşamaları; kalça ve hamstringler kırmızı vurgulu, kalça-kasık bol opak şortla örtülü.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
description: A horizontal press performed lying on the floor with two dumbbells.
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent, feet planted, and a dumbbell in each hand; let the upper arms approach the floor.
Press both dumbbells above the mid-chest without bouncing the elbows or overextending them.
Lower under control until the upper arms lightly approach the floor again.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the start and finish of Dumbbell Floor Press, with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yerde Dambıl Pres hareketinin başlangıç ve bitişi iki gri karede gösteriliyor; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: A chest isolation movement in which dumbbells are opened in a wide arc while lying on a flat bench.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold light dumbbells over your chest; bend your elbows slightly.
Open your arms to the sides in a wide arc, down to a depth where your shoulders feel comfortable.
Use your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back up; if you feel strain in your shoulders, shorten the range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Fly, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıl Fly hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Forearm Pronation-Supination
description: A light forearm rotation exercise in which a dumbbell held by one end is turned palm up and palm down.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench; hold a very light dumbbell by one end.
Keeping your elbow fixed, slowly turn your palm up, then down.
Return to the start under control; reduce the range or stop if your wrist hurts.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Forearm Pronation-Supination, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Ön Kol Pronasyon-Supinasyon hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge
description: A forward lunge performed while holding a dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side and feet about hip-width apart.
Step one foot forward and lower under control, keeping the front foot flat and the front knee aligned with the toes.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then change sides. Keep both dumbbells hanging at your sides.

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a forward lunge with dumbbells; loose opaque shorts cover the hips and groin and the legs are highlighted red.
alt.tr: Dambılla İleri Hamle hareketinin iki gri aşaması; kalça ve kasık bol, opak şortla kapalı, bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
description: A shoulder isolation exercise that raises dumbbells forward from the thighs to shoulder height.
instructions: Stand tall with a light dumbbell in each hand in front of the thighs; keep the elbows softly bent.
Raise the arms forward to about shoulder height without swinging or leaning back.
Lower slowly to the start; use a light load and stop if the movement causes shoulder pain.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Front Raise; front deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Öne Kaldırış hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; ön omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Front Squat
description: A front-loaded squat holding one dumbbell at each shoulder, keeping the torso upright through the squat.
instructions: Stand about shoulder-width with toes slightly turned out. Hold a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms facing inward, elbows lifted, and brace your trunk.
Bend the hips and knees to lower under control, keeping the dumbbells at shoulder height, chest lifted, heels down, and knees tracking with the toes.
Press through the whole foot to stand tall; keep the torso upright and elbows lifted throughout.

alt.en: Standing and squat phases of a dumbbell front squat with the weights held at shoulder height; quadriceps highlighted red and loose opaque shorts covering the hips and groin.
alt.tr: Dambılların omuz hizasında tutulduğu ön squatın ayakta ve alçalış aşamaları; quadriceps kırmızı vurgulu, kalça ve kasık bol opak şortla örtülü.

name: Dumbbell Kickstand Romanian Deadlift
description: A staggered-stance hinge loading the front leg while the rear foot supports balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, stagger the feet and place most weight on the front foot.
Soften the front knee and push hips back, lowering weights near the leg.
Drive through the front foot and stand; keep the rear foot light.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Kickstand Romanian Deadlift with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Destek Ayaklı Romanian Deadlift hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Lunge
description: A dumbbell is held at the chest while alternating side lunges load one bent leg at a time.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell close to your chest and stand with feet under your hips.
Step wide to one side, bend that knee and send your hips back while the other leg stays long.
Push through the bent leg to return to standing, then repeat on the other side.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Lateral Lunge; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Yana Lunge hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: A standing dumbbell raise that lifts the arms out to the sides to train the side deltoids.
instructions: Hold light dumbbells at your sides; keep your elbows soft and your torso still.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height; do not pull your shoulders toward your ears.
Lower the dumbbells under control; choose a load you can lift without swinging.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Lateral Raise, side deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Yana Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; yan omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: A bench movement in which one dumbbell is moved in an arc from above the chest to behind the head.
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold one light dumbbell over your chest with both hands; keep your elbows soft.
Move your arms in a controlled arc behind your head; stop where your shoulders feel comfortable.
Bring the dumbbell back over your chest; do not over-arch your lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Pullover, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıl Pullover hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Push Press
description: A two-dumbbell overhead press initiated by a shallow leg dip and drive.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at shoulder height and feet hip-width apart.
Dip a few inches by bending the knees, then drive through the floor and press overhead.
Lower to the shoulders and reset before the next repetition.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Push Press with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıl Push Press hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Radial Deviation
description: A light wrist exercise in which an upright dumbbell is raised toward the thumb side of the wrist.
instructions: Rest your forearm on a bench with your wrist hanging off the edge; hold a light dumbbell upright.
Without moving your forearm, raise your wrist in the direction of your thumb through a small range.
Lower the dumbbell slowly to the start; work with a light load and stop if you feel wrist pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Radial Deviation, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Radyal Deviasyon hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Renegade Row
description: An alternating dumbbell row from a high plank.
instructions: Grip two stable dumbbells in a high plank with feet wide.
Keep hips level and row one weight to the lower ribs.
Lower steadily and change arms; use a manageable load.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Renegade Row with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Plank Row hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Lunge
description: A reverse lunge performed while holding a dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and a dumbbell at each side.
Step one foot backward and lower until both knees bend comfortably; keep your front foot flat and torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other side. Keep your head and neck neutral.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show standing and lowered dumbbell reverse-lunge positions, with quadriceps and glutes highlighted red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Geri Hamle hareketinin ayakta ve alçak pozisyonları iki gri karede gösteriliyor; ön bacak ve kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
description: A wrist extension exercise with the palm facing down, using a dumbbell to train the forearm extensors.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh; hold the dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Keeping your forearm still, raise the back of your hand upward in a controlled way.
Lower your wrist slowly; use a small, comfortable range of motion.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Ters Bilek Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip hinge performed with a dumbbell in each hand held close to the legs.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells in front of the thighs; set the feet hip-width apart with the knees slightly bent.
Keeping the back neutral, send the hips back and lower the dumbbells close to the legs.
When you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, bring the hips forward and stand up; do not round the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Romanya Deadlift hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: An overhead press using two independently held dumbbells.
instructions: Hold dumbbells beside the shoulders with palms forward.
Press upward without leaning back, then lower.

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a standing dumbbell shoulder press, with shoulders and upper arms highlighted red.
alt.tr: Ayakta dambıl omuz press hareketinin iki gri tonlu aşaması; omuzlar ve üst kollar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

media.creator: Open Exercise Atlas (AI-assisted edit of original illustration)

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: A standing shrug performed with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides.
instructions: Stand tall holding the dumbbells at your sides and let your arms hang relaxed.
Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears without rolling them forward or back.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the start; do not strain your neck.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Shrug, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
description: A standing lateral trunk-flexion exercise with one dumbbell held at the side.
instructions: Stand tall with one dumbbell at your side and the other hand resting on your thigh.
Slide the dumbbell down the outside of your leg with a small side bend; keep your chest facing forward.
Use your obliques to return upright without twisting or leaning forward.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Side Bend with target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Yana Eğilme hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
description: A lying triceps extension in which light dumbbells are lowered toward the sides of the head by bending the elbows.
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold light dumbbells above your chest; straighten your arms.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows and lower the dumbbells toward the sides of your head.
Extend your elbows under control to return to the start; do not bring the weight close to your head and stay in a comfortable range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Skull Crusher, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Skull Crusher hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Split Squat
description: A stationary split squat with both feet on the floor and a dumbbell held in each hand.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at each side and take a stable split stance with both feet on the floor.
Bend both knees to lower under control; keep the front foot planted and the front knee in line with the toes.
Press through the front foot to rise without stepping; complete the set, then switch legs.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of a stationary dumbbell split squat with both feet on the floor; front-leg muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: İki ayağın yerde kaldığı dambıllı split squat hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; ön bacaktaki kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
description: A dumbbell press in which the dumbbells are pressed together throughout the lift to keep the chest under tension.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold light dumbbells over your chest so that they touch each other.
Keep pressing the dumbbells together as you lower them to your chest under control.
Press up from chest level; set your shoulders on the bench and do not attempt this with heavy loads.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Squeeze Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıl Sıkıştırma Presi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Step Ups
description: A step-up onto a stable box performed with a dumbbell held in each hand.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy box of a manageable height, holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Place one foot fully on the box and rise with that leg, keeping the knee in line with the toes.
Lower the other foot under control and switch sides; make sure the box is stable.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Step Ups, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıllı Step-Up hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Sumo Squat
description: A wide-stance squat holding one dumbbell between the legs, emphasizing hip adduction alongside the squat pattern.
instructions: Stand with feet wider than hip-width and toes turned slightly outward; hold one dumbbell vertically with both hands in front of your hips.
Bend your knees and hips to lower between your legs, keeping heels down and knees tracking in the direction of your toes.
Press through both feet to stand tall again without letting your knees collapse inward.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show standing and lowered positions of a dumbbell sumo squat, with the inner thighs highlighted red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Sumo Squat hareketinin ayakta ve alçak pozisyonları iki gri karede gösteriliyor; iç uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Tate Press
description: A lying dumbbell triceps press with elbows opening outward.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with light dumbbells above the chest, elbows bent and pointed outward.
Extend the elbows while keeping the upper arms steady.
Bend the elbows and lower the weights toward the upper chest.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Tate Press with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Tate Press hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Thruster
description: A front squat that flows directly into a two-dumbbell overhead press.
instructions: Hold two dumbbells at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat to a comfortable depth while keeping the weights steady at your shoulders.
Stand powerfully into an overhead press; lower the weights before the next squat.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Dumbbell Thruster with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıl Thruster hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
description: A bent-over single-arm exercise in which the forearm is extended backward with the upper arm fixed to train the triceps.
instructions: Support one hand on a bench; hinge forward at the hips and hold the dumbbell in your other hand.
Fix your elbow at your side and extend your forearm backward.
Bend your elbow under control to return to the start; do not swing your upper arm and work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Triceps Kickback, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Arka Kol Kickback hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
description: Alternating forward lunges performed while carrying a dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell at each side and feet about hip-width apart.
Take a controlled step forward; lower until both knees bend comfortably, keeping the front foot flat and the front knee aligned over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to rise and bring the back leg forward into the next step; keep your feet on separate tracks.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show standing and forward-lunge positions with dumbbells, with the quadriceps and glutes highlighted red.
alt.tr: Dambıllı Yürüyüş Lunge hareketinin ayakta ve ileri hamle pozisyonları iki gri karede gösteriliyor; quadriceps ve kalçalar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Z Press
description: A dumbbell overhead press performed seated on the floor with the legs extended, which removes leg drive and demands an upright torso.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front; find a position where you can keep your torso upright and bring the dumbbells to shoulder height.
Without leaning back from your lower back, press the dumbbells overhead under control.
Lower the weights slowly to your shoulders; reduce the load if your torso drifts backward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Z Press, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Z Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
description: A standing elbow-flexion exercise using an angled EZ bar to train the biceps.
instructions: Stand tall holding the EZ bar with a comfortable angled grip; keep elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders while keeping your upper arms mostly still.
Lower the bar slowly to the starting position without swinging.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of EZ-Bar Curl; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: EZ Bar Curl hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
description: A lying triceps extension in which an EZ bar is lowered toward the forehead by bending the elbows.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a light EZ bar above your chest; keep your wrists neutral.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows and lower the bar under control to near your forehead.
Extend your elbows to bring the bar back to the start; do not touch the bar to your face and use a spotter if needed.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the EZ-Bar Skull Crusher, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: EZ Barla Skull Crusher hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Face Pull
description: A cable row to the face with a rope that trains the rear deltoids and the muscles around the shoulder blades.
instructions: Attach the rope to a pulley at face height and grip both ends with your thumbs pointing backward.
Pull the rope toward your face by flaring your elbows out; do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears.
Extend your arms under control and keep your torso still.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Face Pull, rear deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Face Pull hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Farmer Carry
description: A loaded walk while holding a weight at each side.
instructions: Pick up weights you can control in each hand and stand tall with the shoulders relaxed back.
Walk with short, balanced steps without leaning to the side.
Put the weights down safely; do not shrug and make sure the path is clear.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Farmer Carry, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çift Taraflı Ağırlık Taşıma hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Floor Crunch
description: A basic floor abdominal exercise in which the shoulder blades are lifted off the ground by bracing the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back, bend your knees and plant your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the floor in a controlled way; do not pull your neck with your hands.
Pause briefly and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing a floor crunch; red highlights show the abdominal muscles and an arrow shows the upward movement.
alt.tr: Yerde crunch yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış ve kırmızı ok yukarı yönlü hareketi gösteriyor.

media.creator: Open Exercise Atlas (AI-assisted edit of Monk Mode illustration)

name: Flutter Kicks
description: A supine core exercise that alternates small, controlled leg lifts while the trunk stays braced.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs extended and hands beside your hips; brace your trunk and keep your lower back gently supported.
Lift both heels slightly, then alternate raising and lowering each leg in a small, controlled range.
Keep the movement smooth and stop or shorten the range if your lower back starts to arch.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Flutter Kicks; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makas Vuruşu hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Forward Lunge
description: A bodyweight lunge that steps forward and returns to the starting stance.
instructions: Stand tall with feet about hip-width apart, brace your trunk, and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Step one foot forward, plant it flat, and lower under control until both knees bend comfortably; keep the front knee tracking in line with the toes.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then repeat on the other side. Keep your balance and use a comfortable range.

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a forward lunge, with loose opaque shorts covering the hips and groin and the quadriceps and glutes highlighted red.
alt.tr: İleri Hamle hareketinin iki gri aşaması; kalça ve kasık bol, opak şortla kapalı, quadriceps ve kalçalar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Frog Pump
description: A floor hip extension performed lying on the back with the soles of the feet together and the knees dropped out.
instructions: Lie on your back, press the soles of the feet together and let the knees fall comfortably to the sides.
Brace the abdomen slightly and lift the hips off the floor without over-arching the lower back.
Squeeze the glutes and hold briefly at the top, then lower to the floor under control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Frog Pump, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kurbağa Pump hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
description: A split squat with the front foot raised on a low stable platform to increase range.
instructions: Place your front foot fully on a low, stable step and take a long split stance.
Lower by bending both knees while keeping the front heel grounded.
Press through the front foot to stand; use a range you can control.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Front-Foot-Elevated Split Squat with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ön Ayak Yükseltilmiş Split Squat hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Front Squat
description: A barbell squat with the load across the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Rest the bar on the front of the shoulders with the elbows raised and feet at a comfortable width.
Brace the abs and squat; track the knees over the toes and keep the heels down.
From a controlled depth, drive through the feet to stand with the torso upright.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Front Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ön Squat hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Full Copenhagen Plank
description: A side plank with the top ankle on a bench and the bottom leg lifted, loading the inner thigh muscles with a short isometric hold.
instructions: Get into a side plank position; place your top ankle on a sturdy bench and align your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips to form a straight line from head to ankle; raise your bottom leg off the floor.
Hold the position briefly and in control, then lower; work both sides and release if you feel pain in the groin.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the full copenhagen plank, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tam Kopenhag Plank yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Glute Bridge
description: A floor-based hip extension movement with the upper back and feet supported.
instructions: Lie on the back with knees bent and feet planted.
Lift the hips until the torso and thighs align, then lower.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing a glute bridge on a mat, glutes highlighted red.
alt.tr: Minderde kalça köprüsü yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Glute Bridge March
description: A glute bridge variation that alternates lifting each foot while keeping the hips elevated and level.
instructions: Lie on a mat with knees bent and feet planted hip-width apart; lift the hips into a bridge.
Brace the abdomen and lift one foot a few inches while keeping the pelvis level.
Set the foot down, alternate sides, and lower the hips after the set; shorten the march if the hips wobble.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Glute Bridge March; glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kalça Köprüsünde Yürüyüş hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Glute-Ham Raise
description: A posterior-chain exercise on a glute-ham developer using controlled knee flexion and extension.
instructions: Adjust the glute-ham developer so your knees rest on the pad and ankles are securely held.
Keep hips extended as you lower your torso forward, then curl back up using your hamstrings.
Use assistance or a shorter range if needed; avoid dropping quickly into the bottom.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Glute-Ham Raise; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Glute-Ham Kaldırışı hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Goblet Squat
description: A squat with a weight held in front of the chest, encouraging an upright torso.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell upright in front of the chest and set your feet at a comfortable width.
Send the hips down and back, keeping the torso upright and the knees tracking over the toes.
Stand by driving through the feet; stay within a depth you can control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Goblet Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Goblet Squat hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Good Morning
description: A barbell hip hinge performed with the bar across the upper back and the torso tipping forward from the hips.
instructions: Place a light bar securely on the upper back; set the feet hip-width apart with the knees slightly bent.
Keep the spine neutral, send the hips back and tip the torso forward from the hips.
When you feel tension in the hamstrings, bring the hips forward and stand up; do not round the lower back and start light.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Good Morning, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Good Morning hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hack Squat
description: A machine squat performed with the back against a pad and the feet on an angled platform.
instructions: Set the shoulders under the pads and the back against the machine; place the feet on the platform at a comfortable width.
Lower the platform under control while the knees travel in line with the feet.
Keeping the heels on the platform, push back up and return to the start without locking the knees at the top.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Hack Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Hack Squat hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Half-Kneeling Band Chest Press
description: A unilateral band press from a half-kneeling stance.
instructions: Kneel with one knee down; anchor a band behind you at chest height and hold it beside your chest.
Brace your trunk and press forward without turning your torso.
Bend the elbow slowly and return; repeat, then switch sides.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Half-Kneeling Band Chest Press with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yarım Diz Çöküşte Bant Göğüs İtişi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Half-Kneeling Band Lat Pulldown
description: A one-arm band pulldown performed from a half-kneeling position with the band anchored overhead.
instructions: Anchor the band above head height; kneel on one knee and grip the band with one hand.
Pull your elbow toward your ribs; keep your torso upright and still.
Extend your arm back up under control; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Half-Kneeling Band Lat Pulldown, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yarım Diz Çökerek Bantla Lat Çekiş hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
description: A single-arm diagonal press using a landmine-mounted barbell while in a half-kneeling stance.
instructions: Set one knee down with the opposite foot forward and hold the bar end at shoulder height on that side.
Brace your trunk and press diagonally upward, keeping your ribs stacked over your pelvis.
Lower with control and complete the set before switching sides.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Half-Kneeling Landmine Press; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yarım Diz Çökerek Landmine Press hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Dumbbell Press
description: A unilateral overhead press performed in a stable half-kneeling stance.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot planted; hold a dumbbell at the shoulder on the kneeling side.
Brace your trunk and press overhead without leaning or rotating.
Lower with control; finish the set and switch sides.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Half-Kneeling Single-Arm Dumbbell Press with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yarım Diz Çökerek Tek Kol Dambıl Press hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hammer Curl
description: A dumbbell curl performed with the palms facing each other that trains the biceps and the brachialis.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other; keep your elbows fixed at your sides.
Raise the dumbbells toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Lower the dumbbells under control without swinging; keep your wrists neutral.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Hammer Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çekiç Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Hamstring Walkout
description: A bodyweight bridge exercise in which the heels walk away from the hips while the hips stay lifted.
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent and the feet close to the hips; lift the hips into a bridge position.
Walk the heels forward in small steps, extending as far as you can while keeping the hips controlled and high.
Walk the heels back with steps and lower the hips; do not arch the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Hamstring Walkout, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Hamstring Walkout hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hand Gripper Squeeze
description: A grip-strength exercise squeezing a spring hand gripper with controlled finger flexion.
instructions: Hold a hand gripper in one hand with the handles resting in your palm and fingers.
Squeeze until the handles meet or reach your comfortable limit; pause briefly.
Open your hand slowly and use a resistance you can control without pain.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Hand Gripper Squeeze with target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: El Kavrama Aleti Sıkma hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hand-Resisted Neck Isometric
description: A gentle isometric neck hold in which one hand provides very light resistance beside the temple.
instructions: Sit upright and keep your head neutral; lightly place your palm beside your temple.
Apply very light resistance with your hand without turning your head, and gently tense your neck muscles.
Hold briefly and release; stop immediately if you feel sharp pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the hand-resisted neck isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: El Dirençli Boyun İzometriği yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
description: A hanging abdominal exercise in which the knees are drawn up toward the chest from a bar.
instructions: Hang from a sturdy bar; move your shoulders away from your ears and keep your torso stable.
Bend your knees, brace your abs and raise your knees toward your chest in a controlled way.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging; perform the movement in a pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the hanging knee raise, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Asılı Diz Çekme yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
description: A hanging knee raise adding controlled side-to-side trunk rotation to emphasize the obliques.
instructions: Hang from a secure pull-up bar with legs together and a firm grip.
Brace your trunk and raise both bent knees diagonally toward one side without swinging.
Lower to center with control, then raise toward the other side.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Hanging Oblique Knee Raise with target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Asılarak Oblik Diz Çekişi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hanging Straight-Leg Raise
description: From a dead hang, straight legs lift forward together and return under control.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and legs straight together.
Without swinging, raise both straight legs forward to about hip height.
Lower your legs slowly to a still hang; bend your knees to shorten the range if needed.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Hanging Straight-Leg Raise; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Asılı Düz Bacak Kaldırış hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hanging Windshield Wiper
description: An advanced hanging core exercise that moves the legs side to side with controlled trunk rotation.
instructions: Hang from a secure pull-up bar with a firm grip and shoulders active; brace your trunk.
Raise your legs in a range you can control, then rotate them a short distance to one side without swinging.
Return to center and lower with control; reduce the range or stop if you cannot prevent momentum.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Hanging Windshield Wiper; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Asılı Windshield Wiper hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Heel-Drop Calf Raise
description: A calf raise from the edge of a step that lets the heels sink below step level for a deeper stretch.
instructions: Press the toes onto the edge of a stable step; take support from a railing or wall for balance.
Lower the heels in a controlled way below step level within a comfortable range.
Rise onto the toes and return slowly to the start; do not bounce and do not go to a depth that causes pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Heel-Drop Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Topuk Düşürmeli Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: High-Cable Double-Biceps Curl
description: A standing curl using two high cable handles with upper arms open.
instructions: Stand between two high pulleys and hold a handle in each hand, arms open.
Curl handles toward the sides of your head, keeping upper arms steady.
Extend slowly to the open position; do not lean back.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of High-Cable Double-Biceps Curl with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yüksek Makarada Çift Kol Biceps Curl hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: High Knees
description: A running-in-place drill alternating quick knee drives to about hip height.
instructions: Stand tall with elbows bent and feet under the hips.
Jog in place, alternating knee drives toward hip height while the opposite arm swings forward.
Land lightly on the balls of the feet and keep the trunk upright; slow to a march if needed.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of High Knees; hip flexors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yüksek Diz Koşusu hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; kalça bükücüler kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: High-to-Low Cable Fly
description: A standing cable chest fly that sweeps the handles down and inward from high pulleys.
instructions: Set both pulleys above shoulder height, take a staggered stance, and hold the handles with a soft bend in your elbows.
Bring your hands down and inward toward the lower chest while keeping your torso steady.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a comfortable chest stretch; do not let the shoulders roll forward.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a high-to-low cable fly, chest highlighted red.
alt.tr: Yukarıdan aşağı cable fly hareketinin iki gri aşaması; göğüs kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hip Airplane
description: A single-leg balance drill that rotates the pelvis open and closed over a hinged hip.
instructions: Stand on one foot with the knee slightly bent; hinge forward at the hips and extend the free leg backward.
With the torso steady, rotate the pelvis open and closed under control; extend the arms to the sides or take support for balance.
Return upright; keep the movement small and pain-free, then switch sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Hip Airplane, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Hip Airplane hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hip Hike
description: A single-leg stance exercise on a step in which the pelvis is lowered and raised to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Stand on one foot at the edge of a low, stable step; hold a railing for balance.
As your free foot drops down beside the step, let your hip lower slightly, then raise your hip with your standing leg.
Keep your torso upright and repeat in a small, controlled range; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the hip hike, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kalça Yükseltme (Hip Hike) yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: A static core hold lying on the back in which the shoulders and feet are lifted while the lower back stays pressed down.
instructions: Lie on your back and gently press your lower back into the floor; start with your knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and feet slightly and hold the position by bracing your abs.
If your lower back starts to lift, bend your knees more; hold for a controlled time without holding your breath.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the hollow body hold, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Hollow Body Tutuşu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
description: A barbell press performed on an inclined bench that emphasizes the upper chest.
instructions: Set the bench to a slight incline, plant your feet on the floor and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Set your shoulder blades on the bench and lower the bar toward your upper chest under control.
Press the bar up while keeping your wrists above your elbows; use a spotter on heavy attempts.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Incline Barbell Bench Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Halter Bench Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: A dumbbell curl performed seated on an incline bench so the arms hang behind the torso, stretching the biceps.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench; let your arms hang down and keep your elbows at your sides.
Raise the dumbbells toward your shoulders without moving your elbows from their place.
Lower the weights slowly; do not round your shoulders forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Incline Dumbbell Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Sehpada Dambıl Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
description: A chest fly performed on an incline bench, lowering dumbbells outward in a controlled arc.
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and lie back with light dumbbells above the upper chest; keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Open the arms in a wide arc until the chest is comfortably stretched, keeping the wrists steady.
Bring the dumbbells back together with control; use a shorter range if the shoulders feel strained.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Incline Dumbbell Fly; chest muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Dambıl Fly hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
description: An upper-chest press performed with dumbbells on a low-incline bench.
instructions: Set a bench to a low incline and hold the dumbbells beside the upper chest.
Press both weights upward without letting them drift together; keep wrists stacked over elbows.
Lower until the upper arms are just below shoulder level, then repeat with control.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Incline Dumbbell Press with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Sehpada Dambıl Press hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Incline Push-Up
description: A push-up with the hands elevated on a stable surface to adjust the load.
instructions: Place hands on a stable raised surface and walk the feet back.
Lower the chest toward the surface, then press away.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing an incline push-up with hands on a bench, chest highlighted red.
alt.tr: Elleri sehpada eğimli şınav çeken gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Inverted Row
description: A bodyweight row performed hanging under a fixed bar with the body held straight.
instructions: Get under a sturdy, waist-height bar and grip it at shoulder width; keep your body straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar and bring your shoulder blades toward each other.
Extend your arms under control and return to the start; do not let your hips drop.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Inverted Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: JM Press
description: A triceps-focused barbell press lowering toward the upper chest with the elbows traveling forward.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and grip the bar just inside shoulder width with wrists straight.
Bend the elbows forward and lower the bar toward the upper chest under control.
Extend the elbows to press up; start light and use a spotter for heavy sets.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of JM Press with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: JM Press hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Jump Rope
description: A rhythmic rope-skipping drill using small, repeated two-foot hops.
instructions: Hold one rope handle in each hand with the rope resting behind your heels.
Turn the rope with small wrist circles and make low hops as it passes under your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and keep the jumps small.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Jump Rope with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: İp Atlama hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Kelso Shrug
description: A shrug variation performed face down on an incline bench that pulls the shoulder blades together.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench and hold light dumbbells with your arms hanging down.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades toward each other.
Pause briefly and lower your shoulders forward under control; do not swing the weight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Kelso Shrug, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kelso Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
description: A hip hinge that lifts a kettlebell from between the feet.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell and hinge to grip its handle.
Push through the feet to stand, then hinge back down.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing a kettlebell deadlift, glutes and hamstrings highlighted red.
alt.tr: Kettlebell deadlift yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça ve arka bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Kettlebell Halo
description: A controlled kettlebell circle around the head with an upright trunk.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a light kettlebell by its horns in front of your chest.
Circle it slowly around your head, keeping it close and ribs stacked over pelvis.
Return to the front and circle the other way within a comfortable range.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Kettlebell Halo with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kettlebell Halo hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift
description: A single-kettlebell deadlift with the weight beside one foot, which resists side bending of the trunk.
instructions: Place the kettlebell beside the outside of one foot; set your feet hip-width apart and hinge at the hips and knees.
Keeping your spine neutral and your shoulders level, lift the kettlebell off the floor.
Lower the weight to the floor along the same controlled path; do not lean sideways and start with a light load.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale suitcase deadlift showing glutes, thigh muscles and lower-back stabilizers in red.
alt.tr: Kettlebell valiz deadlift'in iki aşamalı gri çizimi; kalça, uyluk ve bel sabitleyicileri kırmızı.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: A ballistic hip hinge in which a kettlebell is swung to chest height by a powerful hip drive.
instructions: Hold the kettlebell with both hands and set the feet shoulder-width apart; hinge back at the hips.
Drive the hips forward powerfully but under control and swing the kettlebell to chest height; keep the arms loose.
Let the weight swing back between the legs and hinge at the hips again; do not round the lower back and learn with a light load.

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a kettlebell swing with glutes, hamstrings and inner thighs highlighted red.
alt.tr: Kettlebell swing hareketinin iki gri tonlu aşaması; kalça, arka uyluk ve iç uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

media.creator: Open Exercise Atlas (AI-assisted edit of Monk Mode illustration)

name: Kettlebell Windmill
description: A loaded hip hinge with one kettlebell held overhead while the torso hinges sideways.
instructions: Press a light kettlebell overhead and turn the same-side foot slightly outward.
Keep your eyes on the bell, push your hip out and hinge sideways while the free hand tracks down your thigh.
Stand tall without letting the bell drift; use a very light load while learning.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Kettlebell Windmill with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kettlebell Windmill hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Knee-Supported Copenhagen Plank
description: A side plank variation in which the top knee rests on a bench to load the inner thigh muscles with a short isometric hold.
instructions: Get into a side plank position and place your top knee on a sturdy, non-slip bench.
Lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from head to knee; hold briefly.
Lower in a controlled way; start with short holds and release if you feel pain in the knee or groin.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the knee-supported copenhagen plank, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Diz Destekli Kopenhag Plank yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Kneeling Hip-Flexor Stretch
description: A half-kneeling mobility drill that gently lengthens the hip flexors of the rear leg.
instructions: Kneel on a mat with one foot forward and both knees comfortably bent; keep your torso upright.
Gently brace your abdomen, keep your pelvis level, and shift forward until you feel a mild stretch at the front of the rear hip.
Hold without arching your lower back, return to center, then switch sides.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Kneeling Hip-Flexor Stretch; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Diz Çökerek Kalça Bükücü Esnetmesi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: L-Sit Hold
description: An isometric support hold lifting straight legs forward into an L shape.
instructions: Support yourself on stable parallel bars with elbows straight and shoulders away from your ears.
Brace your trunk and lift both straight legs until they are about horizontal.
Hold while breathing steadily, then lower with control; bend the knees to scale.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of L-Sit Hold with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: L-Sit Tutuşu hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Landmine Rotation
description: A standing rotational exercise guiding a landmine bar through a controlled diagonal arc.
instructions: Secure one end of a barbell in a landmine base and hold the free end with both hands at chest height.
Stand with feet stable and guide the bar in a controlled arc across your body, rotating through the hips and trunk.
Reverse the arc smoothly; use a load that lets you keep control.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Landmine Rotation with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: Landmine Rotasyonu hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Landmine Row
description: A barbell row with one end of the bar anchored in a landmine sleeve.
instructions: Place one end of the bar in a fixed landmine sleeve and take a suitable handle.
Lean your torso forward and keep your back neutral; pull your elbows back and bring the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower the weight to the start without jerking; do not rotate your torso during the pull.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Landmine Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Landmine Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: A vertical cable pull that brings the handle toward the upper chest.
instructions: Sit at a pulldown station and grip the bar.
Pull the bar toward the upper chest, then let it rise slowly.

alt.en: Wide-grip lat pulldown example: seated athlete holding the bar overhead, with lats highlighted red and assisting muscles lighter red.
alt.tr: Geniş tutuşlu lat pulldown örneği: oturan sporcu barı başının üzerinde tutuyor; lat kasları koyu, yardımcı kaslar açık kırmızıyla gösteriliyor.

alt.tr: Geniş tutuşlu önden lat pulldown örneği: oturan sporcu barı üst göğsüne çekiyor; lat kasları koyu, yardımcı kol kasları açık kırmızıyla gösteriliyor.

name: Lateral Band Walk
description: A band-resisted sideways walk in a shallow squat that works the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Place a light band above your knees; set your feet hip-width apart and soften your knees.
Keeping the shallow squat position, take small, controlled steps to the side.
Keep the band tense as you bring your feet back together; travel equally in both directions.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the lateral band walk, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Yana Yürüyüş yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Lateral Hand-Resisted Neck Isometric
description: A gentle isometric neck hold in which the hand resists sideways pressure of the head beside the temple.
instructions: Sit upright and keep your head neutral; lightly place your palm beside your temple.
Apply very light resistance with your hand without moving your head; hold briefly and keep breathing.
Release and switch to the other side; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the lateral hand-resisted neck isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: El Dirençli Yan Boyun İzometriği yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Lateral Lunge
description: A lunge to the side in which the hips shift back over one bent knee while the other leg stays straight.
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart; leave room to step to the side.
Take a wide step to one side and bend that knee, sending your hips back; keep your other leg comfortably straight.
Push through the bent leg to return to the center; let your knee track in the same direction as your toes.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the lateral lunge, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Lunge yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Lateral Step-Down
description: A single-leg lowering drill stepping down sideways from a low platform.
instructions: Stand sideways on a low stable step with one foot near the edge.
Bend the standing knee and lower the free heel toward the floor beside the step.
Tap lightly and press through the step foot to return; track the knee over the toes.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Lateral Step-Down with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yana Basamak İnişi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Lateral Step-Up
description: A lateral step-up variation in which the athlete steps sideways onto a raised platform.
instructions: Stand sideways next to a low, sturdy box and place the nearer foot fully on top.
Push through the elevated foot to step up, keeping your knee aligned with your toes.
Step back down slowly and repeat; switch sides after the set.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Lateral Step-Up; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yana Step-Up hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Leg Extensions
description: A machine knee extension that isolates the front of the thigh.
instructions: Sit in the machine with the back against the support and adjust the pad above the ankles.
Extend the knees in a controlled way and straighten the legs in front of you; do not lock the knees hard.
Lower the weight slowly and keep the movement within a comfortable range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Leg Extensions, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bacak Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Leg Press
description: A machine squat-pattern exercise pressing a weighted platform away with both feet.
instructions: Set the seat so your lower back and hips stay supported; place feet about shoulder-width on the platform.
Lower the platform until your knees bend comfortably without your pelvis rolling up.
Press through the whole foot and stop just short of locking the knees.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Leg Press with target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Leg Press hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
description: A calf raise performed on the leg press by pressing the platform with the balls of the feet.
instructions: Load the leg press lightly; place the toes on the lower part of the platform and let the heels hang free.
Without locking the knees, push through the toes to raise the heels.
Lower the heels under control; keep safe contact with the platform and work in a pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Leg Press Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Leg Press ile Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Low-to-High Cable Fly
description: A standing cable fly that sweeps the handles upward and inward from low pulleys.
instructions: Set both pulleys low, take one handle in each hand, and stand centered with one foot slightly forward.
With soft elbows, sweep your arms forward and upward until your hands meet around chest height; keep your torso steady.
Open your arms and lower the handles under control, stopping at a comfortable chest stretch.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a low-to-high cable fly, chest highlighted red.
alt.tr: Alttan üste kablo fly hareketinin iki gri aşaması; göğüs kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Lying Leg Curls
description: A machine knee flexion performed lying face down that isolates the back of the thigh.
instructions: Lie face down on the machine and set the pad just above the ankles.
Keeping the hips on the bench, bend the knees and bring the heels toward the buttocks under control.
Straighten the legs slowly without dropping the weight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Lying Leg Curls, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yatarak Bacak Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Lying Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
description: Lying on a flat bench, both hands hold one dumbbell as the elbows bend and extend overhead.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell securely with both hands above your shoulders.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight beside and slightly behind your head while keeping your upper arms mostly still.
Extend your elbows to return the dumbbell above your shoulders; use a load you can control safely.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Lying Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yatarak Dambıl Triceps Açışı hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Lying Straight-Leg Raise
description: A supine hip-flexion exercise lifting one straight leg while the other stays grounded.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight and hands beside your hips.
Keep one leg on the floor and lift the other with its knee straight to a comfortable height.
Lower slowly without arching your lower back; switch legs.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Lying Straight-Leg Raise with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yatarak Düz Bacak Kaldırma hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine Chest Press
description: A seated machine press that pushes the handles forward from chest level.
instructions: Adjust the seat height so the handles are at chest level; plant your feet on the floor.
Push the handles forward; keep your shoulders down and do not lock your elbows.
Release the resistance under control and bring the handles back toward your chest.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Machine Chest Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Göğüs Presi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Machine Decline Chest Press
description: A seated plate-loaded press that moves the handles forward along a slight downward path.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles begin near mid-chest; sit back against the pad and secure the seat belt if fitted.
Press the handles forward along the machine's path, keeping your wrists straight and stopping before the elbows lock.
Bring the handles back slowly until you feel a comfortable chest stretch; keep your shoulders against the pad.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas machine expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a seated decline machine chest press, with the chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Oturarak makinede decline göğüs presinin iki gri aşaması; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Machine Glute Kickback
description: A standing single-leg hip extension against a dedicated machine's foot pedal.
instructions: Set the pedal and resistance; rest your chest and forearms on the support, keep one foot planted and place the other foot on the pedal.
Without arching your lower back or turning your pelvis, press the pedal back by extending the working hip.
Return the leg slowly to the start, then complete the set on the other side.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas machine expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a standing machine glute kickback, with the working glute highlighted red.
alt.tr: Ayakta makinede kalça geri itişinin iki gri aşaması; çalışan kalça kası kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine High Row
description: A chest-supported high-row machine movement that pulls the handles down and back toward the torso.
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can reach the handles with a comfortable stretch.
Pull the handles down and back toward your ribs, keeping your chest against the pad.
Extend your arms slowly to return without letting the weight stack drop.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Machine High Row; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Yüksek Row hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine Hip Abduction
description: A seated machine exercise in which the knees are pressed outward against pads to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Adjust the machine; place the outsides of your knees on the pads and keep your torso upright.
Open your knees outward in a controlled way; do not rock your torso or move your lower back.
Slowly release the resistance and bring your knees back to the start.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the machine hip abduction, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Kalça Abdüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
description: A hip thrust performed on a dedicated machine with a pad across the hips.
instructions: Set the back against the support, bring the machine pad to the crease of the hips and plant the feet on the floor.
Keeping the ribs down, lift the hips until the shoulders, hips and knees are in line.
Squeeze the glutes with a brief pause and lower under control without over-arching the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Machine Hip Thrust, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Hip Thrust hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine Incline Chest Press
description: A seated machine press that moves the handles forward and upward from upper-chest level.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles begin around upper-chest height; keep your back on the pad and feet planted.
Press the handles forward and slightly upward with straight wrists, stopping before your elbows lock.
Return the handles slowly to a comfortable upper-chest position without lifting your shoulders from the pad.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas machine expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a seated incline machine chest press, with the chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli makinede oturarak göğüs presinin iki gri aşaması; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine Kneeling Leg Curl
description: A unilateral hamstring curl performed from a supported kneeling position on an iso-lateral machine.
instructions: Kneel on the support pad, lean forward onto the thigh and forearm pads, and set the roller just above the working ankle.
Keep your hips and back steady as you bend the working knee, drawing the heel toward your glute.
Extend the knee slowly without letting the weight stack rest; complete controlled repetitions before switching legs.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a kneeling machine leg curl, working hamstring highlighted red.
alt.tr: Makinede diz çökerek leg curl hareketinin iki gri aşaması; çalışan hamstring kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
description: A seated shoulder-abduction exercise performed by pressing the machine pads outward with the elbows.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the pads sit just above your elbows; sit upright with your arms slightly bent and shoulders relaxed.
Press your elbows outward to raise the pads until your upper arms are near shoulder height; avoid shrugging.
Lower the pads slowly to the start position while keeping your torso still.

alt.tr: Makinede Yana Omuz Açışı hareketinin alçak ve yüksek pozisyonları iki gri karede gösteriliyor; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine Low Row
description: A chest-supported plate-loaded row that pulls the handles back from a low starting angle.
instructions: Set the seat so you can reach the handles with your chest supported and feet firmly on the rests.
Keeping your chest against the pad, pull the handles low toward your lower ribs with your elbows close to your sides.
Extend your arms slowly to return; let the shoulders reach forward without losing contact with the pad.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas machine expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a chest-supported machine low row, with the lats and mid-back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Göğüs destekli makinede alçak row hareketinin iki gri aşaması; kanat ve orta sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Machine Pullover
description: A machine movement in which the upper arms drive pads downward in an arc to work the lats.
instructions: Sit in the machine and place your upper arms on the pads; keep your ribs down and your back supported.
With your elbows slightly bent, pull the arms down in a controlled arc.
Slowly release the resistance and raise your arms back to a comfortable shoulder range; do not overstretch.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Machine Pullover, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Pullover hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Machine Rear-Delt Fly
description: A seated reverse-fly movement on a pec-deck machine that emphasizes the rear deltoids.
instructions: Set the handles around chest height and sit facing the machine pad with a soft bend in your elbows.
Open your arms to the sides through the shoulders; keep your torso against the pad.
Return the handles slowly without letting the weights slam together.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Machine Rear-Delt Fly; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Arka Omuz Açışı hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
description: A seated overhead press on a guided machine that trains the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat and handles to your shoulder height; rest your back on the support and plant your feet on the floor.
Press the handles overhead; do not over-arch your lower back or lock your elbows.
Lower the weight under control and stop at shoulder height.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Machine Shoulder Press, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Omuz Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Meadows Row
description: A one-arm landmine row performed side-on to the bar with a pronated grip on the loaded sleeve and the free hand braced on the front thigh.
instructions: Secure one end of the bar in a landmine pivot and load the free sleeve. Stand side-on in a split stance with the foot opposite the working arm forward; hinge at the hips, brace your free hand on the front thigh, and grip the loaded sleeve overhand.
Let the working shoulder reach forward without rounding your lower back. Keeping your torso still, drive the elbow up and out and row the sleeve along the bar's arc toward your lower chest.
Lower the bar under control to a comfortable stretch without twisting or dropping the plates. Finish one side, then switch arms.

name: Medicine Ball Overhead Slam
description: A full-body power exercise driving a medicine ball down from overhead.
instructions: Hold a non-bouncing medicine ball with both hands and raise it overhead.
Brace your trunk, hinge slightly and drive the ball down in front of your feet.
Retrieve the ball only after it stops moving; use a slam-rated ball and clear space.

name: Neck Extension Isometric
description: A gentle isometric hold in which the head presses backward into the hands to work the back of the neck.
instructions: Sit upright and keep your head neutral; lightly place both hands behind your head.
Press very lightly against your hands without moving your head backward; do not hold your breath.
Release after a short time; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the neck extension isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
