name: Neck Flexion Isometric
description: A gentle isometric hold in which the forehead presses forward into the palm to work the front of the neck.
instructions: Sit upright, keep your head neutral and lightly place your palm on your forehead.
Press very lightly against your hand without moving your head forward; breathe comfortably.
Release after a short time; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the neck flexion isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Boyun Fleksiyon İzometriği yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Neck Rotation Isometric
description: A gentle isometric hold in which the head presses toward a turn against the hand, without moving, to work the neck rotators.
instructions: Sit upright and keep your head neutral; lightly place your palm beside your temple.
Press very lightly toward your hand without turning your head; keep breathing comfortably.
Release after a short time and try the other side; stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the neck rotation isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Boyun Rotasyon İzometriği yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
description: A close parallel-grip cable pulldown that brings the handle toward the upper chest while the elbows travel down beside the torso.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads. Hold a close parallel-grip attachment with your palms facing one another and reach overhead without shrugging.
Keep your torso tall with a small stable lean, then drive your elbows down beside your body and bring the handle toward the upper chest.
Extend your arms slowly overhead, keeping the torso steady and allowing the cable to return under control.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
description: A vertical pull-up performed on parallel handles with the palms facing each other.
instructions: Grip the parallel-handle bar with your palms facing each other; hang without swinging.
Pull your elbows down and toward your body, bringing your chin up to handle level.
Extend your arms under control and return to the start; do not squeeze your shoulders toward your ears.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
description: A bodyweight knee-flexion exercise in which the torso is lowered forward from the knees against anchored ankles.
instructions: Kneel and anchor the ankles under a secure support; keep the body in a straight line from the knees to the head.
Lean slowly forward without bending at the hips; catch yourself with the hands near the floor when needed.
Work only within the range you can control and use the hands for support to return to the start; do not force it and fall.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Nordic Hamstring Curl, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Nordic Hamstring Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: A unilateral dumbbell row with the opposite hand supported on a bench.
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench; keep the back flat and hold the dumbbell in the working hand.
Pull the elbow toward the hip to bring the dumbbell beside the torso; do not rotate the torso.
Lower the dumbbell under control beneath the shoulder; work both sides.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
description: A cable triceps extension performed with the rope held behind the head and the arms extended overhead.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and turn your back to the pulley; hold the rope behind your head.
Fix your elbows beside your head and extend your arms upward under control.
Slowly bend your elbows to return to the start; do not over-arch your lower back.

name: Overhead Dumbbell Shrug
description: A small scapular elevation while two light dumbbells are held overhead.
instructions: Stand stable with two light dumbbells held overhead and elbows straight but not forced.
Raise the shoulder blades slightly toward the ears without bending the elbows or arching the back.
Lower the shoulder blades under control; use a load you can keep stable overhead.

name: Overhead Machine Triceps Extension
description: A seated machine elbow extension performed with the upper arms overhead and shoulders flexed.
instructions: Set the seat and starting lever according to the machine placard. Sit with your back supported and hold the rotating handle; bring your upper arms beside your head with elbows bent.
Keeping your upper arms steady and wrists neutral, extend your elbows to raise the handle overhead without forcefully locking out or arching your back.
Bend your elbows slowly to return the handle behind your head. Use the machine's start assist as directed and choose a load you can control.

name: Standing Overhead Press
description: A standing barbell press that moves the weight from shoulder height to overhead.
instructions: Hold a bar at shoulder height and brace the torso.
Press overhead, then lower to the starting position.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing a standing barbell overhead press, shoulders highlighted red.

name: Pec Deck Fly
description: A machine chest fly bringing the upper arms together against controlled resistance.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles or pads align around mid-chest height.
With a soft bend in the elbows, bring the arms together in front of your chest.
Return slowly until you feel a comfortable chest stretch; avoid forcing the arms far behind you.

alt.tr: Pec Deck Fly hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Pendlay Row
description: A strict barbell row starting each repetition from the floor with the torso nearly parallel.
instructions: Set the bar on the floor and hinge until your torso is nearly parallel, with a neutral spine.
Grip the bar and row it toward the lower chest while keeping the torso angle steady.
Lower the bar to the floor between repetitions and reset your brace.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Pendlay Row with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: Pendlay Row hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Pendulum Squat
description: A machine squat performed under shoulder pads on a guided pendulum arm and footplate.
instructions: Position your shoulders under the pads, place both feet on the platform, and release the machine's safety lock as directed by its placard.
Bend your knees and hips to lower the sled under control, keeping your feet planted and knees aligned with your toes.
Push through the platform to rise; stop short of locking the knees, then engage the safety before stepping out.

name: Pike Push-Up
description: A bodyweight press with hips raised in an inverted V as the head lowers between the hands.
instructions: Place your hands shoulder-width apart and lift your hips high, keeping your legs comfortably bent if needed.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor between your hands while keeping your hips raised.
Press the floor away to return to the start; shorten the range if you cannot stay controlled.

alt.tr: Pike Şınavı hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Pistol Squat
description: A deep single-leg squat with the free leg extended forward for balance.
instructions: Stand on one foot and extend the other leg forward; reach the arms out to balance.
Bend the standing knee and hip to lower only as far as you can keep the heel planted and torso controlled.
Press through the whole foot to stand; use a box or hand support until the full range is steady.

name: Forearm Plank
description: A static forearm support that challenges trunk position and bracing.
instructions: Place forearms and toes on the floor with elbows below shoulders.
Brace the torso and hold a straight body line while breathing.

name: Plate Front Raise
description: A front raise performed with a weight plate held in both hands to train the front deltoids.
instructions: Hold a light weight plate in both hands in front of your thighs; keep your knees soft.
Keeping your elbows slightly bent, raise the plate forward to shoulder height.
Lower the plate slowly without swinging your torso; stop the movement if shoulder pain appears.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Plate Front Raise, front deltoids highlighted in red.

name: Plate-Loaded Assisted Nordic Hamstring Curl
description: A kneeling Nordic curl on a counterbalanced plate-loaded machine; additional load on the assistance horns reduces the effort required.
instructions: Set assistance according to the machine placard; on this counterbalanced model, adding weight increases assistance. Adjust the torso pad and secure your ankles beneath the rollers.
Keep your body straight from knees through shoulders and slowly lean forward from the knees, resisting the descent with your hamstrings.
Use your hamstrings to curl back to kneeling under control; increase assistance if you cannot control the full range.

name: Plate-Loaded Ground Base High Pull
description: A standing high pull using independent, plate-loaded arms, combining a controlled leg and hip drive with an upward pull to the lower chest.
instructions: Load both independent arms evenly. Stand with feet planted, hold the long handles near thigh level, and set a stable athletic stance with hips hinged and knees bent.
Drive through your feet and extend your hips and knees as you pull the handles close to your body toward the lower chest; let the elbows lead without rising above shoulder level.
Lower the handles under control to the start. Begin with a light load, avoid jerking the arms, and stop if the movement causes shoulder pain.

name: Plate-Loaded Ground Base Jammer Press
description: A standing, plate-loaded press in which an athletic stance and leg drive help move independent handles forward and upward along the machine's arc.
instructions: Load the independent arms evenly. Stand in a stable split stance with the handles near upper-chest height, wrists straight, and knees softly bent.
Brace your trunk and press the handles forward and upward along the machine's path while keeping your feet planted and torso controlled.
Let the handles return slowly to the start without letting the arms pull your shoulders forward. Use a load you can control and keep clear of the moving arms.

name: Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral D.Y. Row
description: A chest-supported plate-loaded row with underhand grips and overhead-pivot arms that follow a natural downward-and-back arc.

Pull the handles down and back toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows behind you; keep your chest on the pad.
Let the independent arms travel forward slowly until your shoulders reach a comfortable stretch; avoid jerking or lifting your chest.

name: Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Decline Chest Press
description: An upright seated decline chest press with independent plate-loaded arms and a downward-forward pressing path.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles begin near the lower chest; brace your back against the pad and secure your feet.
Press the independent handles forward and slightly downward, keeping your wrists straight and elbows softly bent.
Let the handles return slowly until your elbows are comfortably behind your torso; keep the plates controlled.

Keeping your torso steady, pull the handles down and slightly back toward your upper chest by driving your elbows toward your sides.
Allow the arms to rise overhead slowly under control without letting the plates drop between repetitions.

Control the arms as they return forward to a comfortable stretch; do not let the plates drop.

Press both independent handles upward and forward without locking your elbows or lifting your back from the pad.
Lower the handles slowly until you feel a comfortable chest stretch; keep both sides controlled.

description: A prone knee curl on a plate-loaded machine with independent arms for unilateral hamstring training.
instructions: Load both arms evenly, lie face down, and align your knees with the pivots; place the roller just above your ankles and hold the stabilizing handles.
Keep your hips and torso on the pads and curl your heels toward your buttocks without arching your lower back.
Lower the independent arms slowly until your knees are nearly straight, keeping the plates under control.

name: Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Leg Extension
description: A seated knee extension on a plate-loaded machine with independent arms for unilateral or bilateral quadriceps training.
instructions: Load both arms evenly, align your knees with the pivots, adjust the back pad, and secure the thigh belt; place the shin rollers just above the ankles.
Keep your back against the pad and extend one or both knees smoothly until the legs are nearly straight; do not snap the knees into lockout.
Lower the independent arms slowly to a comfortable bend, keeping the plates under control.

Let the arms travel forward slowly to a comfortable stretch without letting the plates drop.

description: A chest-supported horizontal row using independent plate-loaded arms, converging handles, and several grip options.

Lower the handles slowly to the start position, keeping your shoulders down and both arms controlled.

name: Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Wide Chest Press
description: An upright seated plate-loaded chest press with independent arms that begin wide and converge as the handles are pressed forward.

Return the handles slowly until you feel a comfortable chest stretch. Do not force the wide start position or let the shoulders roll forward.

description: A seated wide-grip pulldown using independent plate-loaded arms that travel down and slightly back.

description: A seated plate-loaded hand-grip exercise with multiple handle orientations for training grip strength through controlled finger flexion.
instructions: Choose a comfortable pronated or supinated handle position, sit upright, and set a light load that lets you keep your wrists straight.
Close the handles by flexing your fingers; keep your wrists still and avoid leaning your body into the squeeze.
Let the handles open slowly under control and stop before your grip slips.

description: A trap-focused shrug performed seated or standing on a plate-loaded machine with side-positioned handles for shoulder alignment.
instructions: Choose the seated or standing setup, set the machine stops if present, and hold the side handles with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders vertically toward your ears without bending your elbows or rolling your shoulders.
Lower your shoulders slowly to the start position while keeping the plates under control.

name: Plate-Loaded Reverse Lunge
description: An alternating reverse lunge on a guided plate-loaded machine, with the rear foot moving on a sliding inclined platform.
instructions: Follow the machine placard to set the shoulder pad and starting position. Place the front foot on the fixed platform and the rear foot on the sliding platform; hold the handles and brace your torso.
Bend both knees and lower under control as the rear platform glides back along its inclined guide. Keep the front foot planted and the front knee aligned with the toes.
Press through the front foot to return to the start while guiding the handles smoothly. Complete the repetitions on one side, then switch; use a load you can control.

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a plate-loaded guided reverse lunge; the rear foot slides on an inclined platform. The athlete wears opaque shorts and quadriceps are highlighted red.

name: Plate-Loaded Seated Dip
description: A seated dip machine with plate-loaded lever arms lets the user press down from a supported position to train the triceps.
instructions: Choose the face-in setup, adjust the seat so the handles are within comfortable reach, plant your feet, and secure the thigh restraint if present.
Keep your torso against the support and press the handles down until your elbows are nearly straight; do not snap them into lockout.
Let the handles rise slowly until your elbows bend comfortably, keeping the plates under control.

name: Plate-Loaded Super Fly
description: A seated plate-loaded chest fly with paired work arms and adjustable flat or decline paths.
instructions: Load both sides evenly, choose a flat or decline path, and set the range stop before sitting; adjust the seat so the handles start around mid-chest.
With your back supported and elbows softly bent, bring the handles together in a smooth arc without shrugging.
Open your arms slowly to a comfortable chest stretch; do not force your elbows far behind your torso.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle gap follow-up

name: Plate-Loaded Super Squat Press
description: A plate-loaded squat machine with articulating foot platforms and independent work arms that allow each leg to move separately.
instructions: Load both sides evenly and set the machine safety; place your shoulders and back against the pads and both feet securely on the platforms.
Bend your hips and knees to lower into a comfortable squat while keeping your heels planted and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through the platforms to stand, stop before locking your knees, then engage the safety before stepping off.

name: Plate-Loaded Tibia Dorsi-Flexion
description: A seated plate-loaded ankle dorsiflexion exercise that raises the forefoot toward the shin to train the tibialis anterior.
instructions: Sit with your lower back supported, place your thighs under the restraint, and position the padded lever over the front of your shoe; begin with a light load.
Keep your knee still and lift your forefoot toward your shin by moving at the ankle.
Lower the lever slowly until you feel a comfortable stretch; avoid bouncing or forcing the ankle range.

name: Plate Pinch
description: A static grip hold in which two weight plates are pinched together between the fingers and thumb to train grip and forearm strength.
instructions: Pinch two weight plates together with your fingertips, smooth sides facing outward.
Keeping your shoulders relaxed, continue gripping the plates beside you for a controlled period of time.
Lower the plates safely without dropping them on your feet; if you are about to lose your grip, put them down on the floor.

name: Plate Pinch Carry
description: A grip carry pinching weight plates between the fingers and thumb.
instructions: Pinch a light plate at your side with fingers on one face and thumb on the other.
Stand tall and walk with short steps, keeping the plate clear of your leg.
Set it down safely before your grip fails; change hands.

alt.tr: Plaka Sıkıştırarak Yürüme hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Pogo Hops
description: A low-amplitude plyometric drill of small, rhythmic hops driven from the ankles.
instructions: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart and the knees slightly softened.
Make small, rhythmic hops from the ankles, touching the floor lightly with the forefoot.
Continue with soft landings without bending the knees deeply; stop if you feel discomfort.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Pogo Hops, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Pogo Sıçramaları hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Preacher Curl
description: An EZ-bar curl performed with the upper arms resting on a preacher pad, which limits swinging and isolates the biceps.
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench and place your upper arms on the pad; grip the EZ bar with your palms facing up.
Without lifting your elbows from the pad, curl the bar toward your shoulders under control.
Lower the bar slowly; do not lock your elbows hard and do not swing the load.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Preacher Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Scott Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Prone Cobra Hold
description: A prone isometric hold in which the chest and hands are lifted slightly off the floor.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms beside your body and rest your forehead comfortably on the floor.
Keeping your neck neutral, lift your chest and hands slightly; gently draw your shoulder blades down and back.
Hold briefly and lower under control; if you feel discomfort in your lower back, reduce the lift height or stop.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Prone Cobra Hold, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yüzüstü Kobra Tutuşu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Prone Incline Y Raise
description: A light dumbbell raise performed face down on an incline bench with the arms moving into a Y shape.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with light dumbbells; extend your arms in a Y shape in front of your head.
With your thumbs pointing up, raise your arms under control; keep your neck and torso still.
Lower the dumbbells slowly; if you feel pinching in your shoulders, reduce the weight or stop the movement.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Prone Incline Y Raise, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Sehpada Yüzüstü Y Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Prone Reverse Hyperextension
description: A supported prone hip extension raising the legs with the posterior chain.
instructions: Lie face down with hips supported on a stable bench; hold its sides and keep spine neutral.
With knees softly bent, lift legs until they align with your torso.
Lower slowly without swinging or arching the lower back.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Prone Reverse Hyperextension with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yüzüstü Ters Hiperekstansiyon hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Prone Snow Angel
description: A prone upper-back drill sweeping the arms from the hips toward an overhead Y.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your chest supported and arms beside your hips.
Keeping elbows straight, sweep both arms outward and overhead into a comfortable Y.
Lower along the same path without shrugging or arching your lower back.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Prone Snow Angel with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yüzüstü Snow Angel hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Prone T Raise
description: A prone arm raise that draws the shoulder blades together in a T shape.
instructions: Lie chest-down on a bench with light dumbbells hanging below the shoulders.
Raise the arms outward into a T without lifting the torso or shrugging.
Lower slowly to the hanging position.

name: Prone Trap-3 Raise
description: A light dumbbell raise performed face down on an incline bench with the arms moving along a Y line.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with light dumbbells; let your arms hang in a Y shape in front of your head.
With your thumbs pointing up, raise your arms under control along the Y line; keep your neck neutral.
Lower the dumbbells slowly; if you feel pinching in your shoulders, reduce the load or stop.

name: Prone W Raise
description: A face-down shoulder-blade raise that forms a W.
instructions: Lie face down and bend elbows beside the ribs into a W.
Draw the shoulder blades together and lift hands and elbows slightly.
Lower with control and relax the neck.

alt.tr: Yüzüstü W Kaldırışı hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Pull-Up

instructions: Hang from a secure bar with an overhand grip.
Pull the chest toward the bar, then lower under control.

alt.tr: Barfiks çeken gri tonlu sporcu; sırt ve orta sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Push-Up
description: A bodyweight horizontal press performed in a plank position.
instructions: Set hands under or slightly wider than the shoulders in a plank.
Lower the chest with a straight torso, then press back up.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing a push-up, chest and triceps highlighted red.
alt.tr: Şınav çeken gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs ve triseps kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Quadruped Adductor Rockback
description: A gentle mobility drill rocking hips back with one leg extended to the side.
instructions: Start on hands and knees and extend one leg to the side with foot flat.
Keep your back long and shift hips toward heels to a mild inner-thigh stretch.
Return forward within a comfortable pain-free range; switch sides.

name: Quadruped Fire Hydrant
description: A quadruped exercise in which a bent knee is lifted out to the side to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Get on your hands and knees; place your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Keeping your knee bent, lift one leg out to the side; keep your pelvis parallel to the floor and your torso still.
Slowly lower the knee and switch sides; work in a pain-free range without rotating your lower back sideways.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the quadruped fire hydrant, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dört Ayak Üzerinde Fire Hydrant yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Rack Pull
description: A partial deadlift from rack supports set just below the knees, loading the back and hips.
instructions: Place the bar on safe rack supports just below your knees; set your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and knees and grip the bar; keeping your back neutral, stand up and carry the bar close to your legs.
Send your hips back and lower the bar onto the supports under control; use a spotter and suitable rack for heavy loads.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Rack Pull, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Rack Pull hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Reverse Crunch
description: A floor abdominal exercise in which the knees are drawn toward the chest and the pelvis is curled off the ground.
instructions: Lie on your back and bend your knees; place your arms on the floor beside your torso.
Brace your abs, bring your knees toward your chest and lift your pelvis slightly off the floor.
Lower your legs back to the start in a controlled way without swinging them.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the reverse crunch, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Crunch yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Reverse EZ-Bar Curl
description: A curl with an overhand grip on an EZ bar that emphasizes the forearm muscles and the brachioradialis.
instructions: Grip the EZ bar with an overhand grip; keep your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight.
Keeping your elbows fixed, raise the bar toward your chest under control.
Lower the bar slowly; reduce the load or stop if your wrists feel uncomfortable.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Reverse EZ-Bar Curl, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: EZ Barla Ters Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown
description: A seated cable pulldown uses an underhand grip and brings the bar toward the upper chest.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with thighs secured and take an underhand grip just inside shoulder width.
Keeping your torso steady, draw the bar toward your upper chest by driving your elbows down.
Let the bar rise under control until your arms are extended; avoid leaning back or pulling behind your head.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Tutuş Lat Pulldown hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown
description: A cable pushdown performed with an underhand grip on a straight bar to train the triceps.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip it with your palms facing up; keep your elbows close to your torso.
Keeping your upper arms still, extend your elbows and push the bar down.
Bend your arms under control to return to the start; keep your wrists in a comfortable position.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown, triceps highlighted in red.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: A prone hip-extension exercise on a reverse-hyper bench in which the legs swing up to torso level.
instructions: Lie face down on the reverse-hyper bench with your hips supported at the edge of the pad.
Raise your legs under control until they are in line with your torso; do not over-arch your lower back.
Lower your legs slowly; work within a small, pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Reverse Hyperextension, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Hiperekstansiyon hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: A single-leg movement that steps backward before returning to a standing position.
instructions: Stand upright and step one foot back.
Lower both knees under control, return and change sides.

name: Reverse Lunge to Knee Drive
description: A reverse lunge followed by a controlled knee drive using the planted leg for balance.
instructions: Stand tall and step one foot back into a comfortable reverse lunge.
Push through the front foot and bring the rear knee toward hip height without leaning back.
Return to the lunge with control; complete the side and switch.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
description: A kneeling bodyweight exercise in which the torso leans back from the knees to load the front of the thighs.
instructions: Kneel with a pad under the knees; keep the hips open and the torso straight.
Keeping the hips in line, lean the torso back slightly from the knees.
Squeeze the front of the thighs to return upright; start with a small range and stop if the knees hurt.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Reverse Nordic Curl, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Nordic Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Reverse-Plank Leg Lift
description: A reverse-plank hold adding a controlled straight-leg lift to train hip extension.
instructions: Sit with hands behind you and feet planted; lift your hips into a reverse plank.
Keep your trunk steady and raise one straight leg a short distance.
Lower the leg, then switch sides while keeping hips lifted if comfortable.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Reverse-Plank Leg Lift with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Plankta Bacak Kaldırma hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Reverse Sled Drag
description: Facing the sled, the athlete walks backward against the straps to drag it along the floor.
instructions: Face the sled and hold the straps with light tension, knees slightly bent.
Take short backward steps away from the sled while pulling it along the floor.
Keep a steady pace and upright torso; choose a load that allows smooth steps.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Reverse Sled Drag; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Geriye Kızak Çekişi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: A barbell hip hinge performed with soft knees and the weight kept close to the legs.
instructions: Hold the bar in front of the thighs with a slight knee bend and a neutral spine.
Send the hips back and lower the bar close to the legs.
When you feel the hamstrings stretch, drive the hips forward to stand; do not pull with the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Romanian Deadlift, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Romanya Deadlift hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Russian Twist
description: A seated controlled trunk rotation with bent knees and light foot support.
instructions: Sit with knees bent, heels lightly on the floor, and the torso leaned back slightly.
Rotate the chest and clasped hands toward one side while keeping the pelvis steady.
Move through center to the other side under control; avoid forcing the lower back.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
description: A hanging movement in which the shoulder blades are drawn down to raise the body slightly without bending the elbows.
instructions: Hang from a sturdy bar with your arms straight and your shoulders away from your ears.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades down to raise your body a very small amount.
Return under control to a relaxed hang; repeat in a small range without swinging.

name: Seal Row
description: A dumbbell row performed lying face down on a high bench so the torso is fully supported.
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench with your chest supported and your arms hanging down; hold light dumbbells.
Pull your elbows back and raise the dumbbells toward the bench; do not lift your torso off the support.
Lower the weights under control and do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seal Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Seal Row hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Seated Active Neck Rotation
description: A gentle active turn of the head while the shoulders stay still.
instructions: Sit tall with shoulders relaxed and eyes forward.
Turn the head gently toward one side within a comfortable range while the torso stays still.
Return to center and repeat on the other side; stop if pain, numbness, or dizziness occurs.

name: Seated Back Extension
description: A seated machine exercise in which the torso extends from the hips against pad resistance.
instructions: Adjust the machine so your hips can hinge freely and the torso pad makes comfortable contact.
Lean your torso forward from the hips; keeping your back neutral, extend back up to an upright position under control.
Return to the start without taking your torso past upright; stop if you feel pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Back Extension, lower back highlighted in red.

name: Seated Band Hip Abduction
description: A seated outward knee movement against a loop band.
instructions: Sit upright with feet flat and a light loop band just above the knees.
Move both knees outward against the band without lifting the feet or leaning back.
Bring the knees inward slowly without letting the band snap them together.

name: Seated Cable Chest Press
description: A supported horizontal chest press using two cable handles at mid-chest height.
instructions: Set two cable pulleys around mid-chest height. Sit upright on a backed bench between them, plant your feet, and hold one handle beside each side of your chest.
Keep your back against the support and press both handles forward at chest height until your elbows are almost straight; keep your wrists neutral.
Return the handles slowly toward your chest without letting the cables pull your shoulders forward or arching your lower back.

name: Seated Cable Row

Pull toward the torso, then extend the arms under control.

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: A machine calf raise performed seated with the knees bent and the pad resting on the thighs.
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the knee pad on the thighs; set the toes on the platform.
Lower the heels in a controlled way, then push through the toes to raise them.
Pause briefly at the top and lower the weight to the start without jerking.

name: Seated Close-Grip Cable Row
description: A seated cable row with a close-grip handle that is pulled toward the lower ribs.
instructions: Place your feet on the platform, bend your knees slightly and grip the handle.
Without swinging your torso, pull your elbows back and bring the handle toward your lower ribs.
Extend your arms under control without letting your shoulders drop forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Close-Grip Cable Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Oturarak Dar Tutuşlu Kablo Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Seated Decline Cable Press
description: A supported chest press that moves two independent cable handles forward and downward from the lower chest toward the thighs.
instructions: Sit with your back against the support, feet planted, and one handle just below each side of your chest; keep wrists neutral and shoulder blades down and back.
Press the handles forward and down toward your thighs while keeping your back and shoulder blades supported.
Stop before locking your elbows, then slowly return the handles toward your lower chest without rounding your shoulders.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
description: A seated calf raise performed with a dumbbell resting on the thighs just above the knees.
instructions: Sit on a bench; place the toes on a low, stable raised surface and bend the knees to about a right angle.
Place the dumbbell securely just above the knees and raise the heels in a controlled way.
Pause briefly and lower the heels slowly; do not press the weight into the kneecaps and do not bounce.

name: Seated Dumbbell Finger Curl
description: A seated grip exercise that rolls a light dumbbell toward the fingertips and closes the fingers around it.
instructions: Sit with forearms supported on the thighs, palms up, and light dumbbells held securely.
Let the handles roll toward the fingertips without releasing them, then close the fingers firmly around the handles.
Return slowly; use a load you can control throughout.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: An overhead press performed seated on a bench with back support, with a dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, with your wrists above your elbows.
Keeping your torso still, press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells under control to shoulder height; do not over-arch your lower back.

name: Seated Dumbbell Wrist Curl
description: A seated wrist curl with the palms facing up and the forearms supported on the thighs to train the forearm flexors.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, letting your wrists hang freely in front of your knees.
Grip the dumbbells; with your forearms still, curl your wrists upward under control.
Lower the weight slowly and keep the movement within a pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Dumbbell Wrist Curl, forearms highlighted in red.

name: Seated High Back Cable Row
description: A seated cable row using a wide overhand bar and elbows out, pulling toward the upper chest to emphasize the upper back.
instructions: Sit facing a low cable with your knees softly bent and feet braced. Hold a wide straight bar with an overhand grip and keep your back tall.
Pull the bar toward your upper chest with your elbows traveling out to the sides; keep your torso steady and avoid shrugging.
Straighten your arms slowly to return the weight under control without rounding your back.

name: Seated Hip Adduction
description: A seated machine exercise in which the legs are squeezed together against pads to work the inner thigh muscles.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your body and place the insides of your knees on the pads.
Lean back against the support and bring the pads together in a controlled way.
Resist the pull of the weight and slowly open your legs back to the start.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the seated hip adduction, adductors highlighted in red.

name: Seated Single-Leg Hip Flexion
description: A seated single-knee lift driven by the front of the hip.
instructions: Sit tall on a stable bench with both feet on the floor and hands holding the bench edges.
Lift one bent knee toward the chest without leaning back or swinging the torso.
Lower the foot slowly and switch legs.

name: Seated Incline Cable Press
description: A back-supported incline chest press using two independent cable handles that travel forward and upward from the upper chest.
instructions: Sit with your back against the incline support, feet planted, and one handle beside each side of your upper chest; keep wrists neutral and shoulder blades down and back.
Press the handles forward and upward toward forehead height without arching your lower back or rounding your shoulders.
Stop just short of locking the elbows, pause briefly, then return the handles slowly to the upper chest.

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a back-supported seated incline cable press, chest highlighted red; loose opaque shorts cover the hips and groin.

name: Seated Leg Curl
description: A machine knee flexion performed seated that isolates the back of the thigh.
instructions: Adjust the machine so the knee joint lines up with the pivot and the lower-leg pad sits above the ankle.
Pull the heels down and back to bend the knees; keep the hips and back on the seat.
Slowly extend the legs back to the start; do not let the weight slam.

alt.tr: Oturarak Bacak Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Seated Machine Biceps Curl
description: A seated elbow-flexion exercise performed with the upper arms supported on a machine pad.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the machine pivot; sit upright and place your upper arms on the angled pad.
Keeping your wrists neutral and upper arms on the pad, curl the handles toward your chest without rocking your torso.
Lower the handles slowly until your arms are nearly straight, without locking your elbows.

name: Seated Machine Crunch
description: A seated abdominal crunch against a selectorized machine's torso resistance.
instructions: Adjust the seat and resistance; sit with hips against the back of the seat, feet planted and hands on the handles.
Keep your hips seated and curl your rib cage gently toward your pelvis as the handles move down.
Return slowly without jerking the weight or pulling with your arms; keep your neck relaxed.

name: Seated Machine Leg Press
description: A selectorized seated leg press that drives a footplate away while the back and hips stay supported.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your back and hips remain supported and your knees are comfortably bent at the start; place both feet on the footplate.
Press the footplate away through your whole feet without lifting your hips from the seat.
Bend your knees under control to return the footplate, stopping before your lower back or pelvis rolls away from the pad.

name: Seated Machine Row
description: A chest-supported horizontal row using a selectorized machine's independent handles.
instructions: Adjust the seat and chest pad so the handles are near mid-torso height; plant your feet on the rests and reach for the handles.
Keep your chest against the pad and pull the handles horizontally toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows behind you.
Extend your arms slowly without letting the weight stack pull your torso forward.

name: Seated Machine Triceps Extension
description: A seated machine elbow extension with the upper arms supported on a pad.
instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows align with the machine pivots; rest your upper arms on the pads and hold the handles with neutral wrists.
Keep the upper arms supported and extend the elbows to move the handles forward and down without locking out.
Bend the elbows slowly to return the handles, keeping your back against the support.

name: Seated Neck CARs
description: A slow small-range neck mobility sequence performed seated.
instructions: Sit tall with shoulders relaxed and gaze forward.
Slowly turn the head and trace a gentle arc with the chin without forcing range.
Return to center and reverse; stop for pain, dizziness or unusual symptoms.

name: Side Crunch
description: A floor-based lateral trunk-flexion exercise that brings the ribs toward the hip on one side.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and hips stacked; place your upper hand lightly by your head or torso.
Brace your trunk and lift your rib cage toward your hip in a short side crunch.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides; keep the movement small and controlled.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Side Crunch; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Mekik hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
description: A side-lying exercise in which the top leg is lifted from the hip to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side and support your head with your arm; keep your top leg straight and your torso stable.
Lift your top leg from the hip in a controlled way; try not to turn your foot forward.
Slowly lower your leg and work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the side-lying hip abduction, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Yatarak Kalça Abdüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
description: A side-lying exercise in which the bottom leg is lifted off the floor to work the inner thigh muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side; bend your top leg and place that foot on the floor in front of your bottom leg.
Keeping your bottom leg straight, lift it off the floor in a controlled way.
Slowly lower your leg; work both sides without rolling your hips backward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the side-lying hip adduction, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Yatarak Kalça Addüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Side-Lying Thoracic Windmill
description: A side-lying thoracic-rotation mobility drill with the knees stacked and the top arm opening across the body.
instructions: Lie on your side with hips and knees bent and stacked; extend both arms in front.
Keep the knees together and sweep the top arm in a wide arc toward the floor behind you.
Rotate through the upper back only; keep the head comfortable and return to the start.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Side-Lying Thoracic Windmill with target areas highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Yatarak Üst Sırt Windmill hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef bölgeler kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Side Plank
description: A static side support that challenges lateral trunk stability.
instructions: Lie on one side and support the body on a forearm.
Lift the hips to align the body and hold; switch sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete holding a side plank on the forearm, obliques highlighted red.
alt.tr: Ön kol üzerinde yan plank yapan gri tonlu sporcu; yan karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Side Plank Hip Abduction
description: A forearm side plank in which the top leg is lifted to work the outer hip muscles while the trunk stays stable.
instructions: Get into a forearm plank position; start with your bottom knee on the floor if needed.
Stack your hips and lift your top leg upward in a controlled way.
Lower the leg and switch sides; work within the range where you can keep your lower back from rotating.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the side plank hip abduction, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Planktan Kalça Abdüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Side Plank Reach-Through
description: A side-plank rotation reaching the top arm underneath the trunk and opening again.
instructions: Set a forearm side plank with your elbow below your shoulder and hips lifted.
Reach the top arm under your torso and rotate only as far as you can control.
Open your chest and return the arm upward; switch sides after the set.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Side Plank Reach-Through with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Plank Altından Kol Uzatma hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Side-Plank Star
description: A side plank with the top leg lifted to challenge lateral hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with supporting elbow below shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift hips, then raise the top leg and reach the upper arm if stable.
Lower with control; bend the knees for an easier version.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Side-Plank Star with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yıldız Yan Plank hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Side V-Up
description: A side-lying trunk flexion exercise that lifts the legs and upper body toward each other.
instructions: Lie on one side with legs together and the lower arm extended for support; brace your trunk.
Lift both legs and your upper body toward each other in a controlled side crunch.
Lower smoothly to the start, repeat, then switch sides; use a smaller range if needed.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Side V-Up; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan V-Up hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
description: A single-arm lateral raise performed with a low cable to train the side deltoids with constant tension.
instructions: Use a low pulley; stand sideways to the cable and grip the handle with your far hand.
Keeping your elbow slightly bent, raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower your arm slowly without swinging your torso; reduce the range if you feel pinching in the shoulder.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise, side deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Kollu Kablo Yana Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; yan omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
description: A single-arm cable pushdown that extends the elbow against a high cable to train the triceps one side at a time.
instructions: Set the cable to the upper position and grip the single handle; keep your elbow fixed at your side.
Extend your elbow and push the handle down; do not move your upper arm or shoulder.
Raise your forearm back to the start under control; work both arms equally.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single-Arm Cable Pushdown, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Kollu Kablo Arka Kol İtişi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Single-Arm Cable Row
description: A unilateral cable row performed from a stable standing stance, pulling one handle toward the lower ribs.
instructions: Set a single cable handle around lower-chest height. Face the pulley in a stable split stance with your working arm extended and torso upright.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs by driving your elbow back close to your side; keep your shoulders and hips square.
Return the handle slowly until your arm is extended again without letting the cable rotate your torso; repeat on the other side.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Chest Press
description: A unilateral dumbbell chest press performed on a flat bench while resisting torso rotation.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted; hold one dumbbell beside the chest and keep the free hand safely at your side.
Press the dumbbell above the chest while keeping both shoulders and hips level.
Lower under control and repeat; switch arms and use a load that lets you resist torso rotation.

name: Single-Arm High Cable Row
description: A standing unilateral row from a high pulley toward the lower ribs.
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley and reach one arm up to take the handle.
Pull the elbow down toward the lower ribs while keeping the torso steady.
Extend the arm upward under control; repeat on the other side.

name: Single-Arm Iso-Lateral Machine Row
description: A unilateral chest-supported row on a plate-loaded machine with independent work arms.
instructions: Sit against the chest pad, plant your feet, and grasp both independent handles; keep the non-working hand braced on its handle.
Pull one elbow toward your hip without rotating your torso or lifting your chest from the pad.
Extend that arm slowly, then repeat on the other side; keep the plates controlled throughout.

name: Single-Arm Kneeling Lat Pulldown
description: A one-arm cable pulldown performed from a kneeling position beside a high pulley.
instructions: Attach a single handle to the high pulley; kneel beside the machine and grip the handle with your upper hand.
Keeping your torso upright and still, pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Extend your arm back up under control; work both sides.

name: Single-Arm Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
description: A unilateral overhead elbow extension with the upper arm held beside the head.
instructions: Stand tall with one light dumbbell overhead and the upper arm beside the ear; bend the elbow to lower it behind the head.
Extend the elbow until the arm is nearly straight, without arching the back.
Lower slowly behind the head and switch arms after the set.

name: Single-Dumbbell Suitcase March
description: A one-sided loaded march resisting trunk side-bending while alternating knee lifts.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your side and stand tall.
Lift the opposite knee to about hip height without leaning toward the weight.
Lower the foot quietly and alternate sides while keeping your trunk steady.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Single-Dumbbell Suitcase March with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: Tek Dambılla Suitcase March hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single-Leg Box Squat
description: A single-leg squat lowering to a box and standing again without using the free leg.
instructions: Stand on one leg in front of a stable box and extend the free leg forward.
Reach your hips back and lightly touch the box without dropping onto it.
Press through the planted foot to stand; use a higher box to scale.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Single-Leg Box Squat with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Bacak Box Squat hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
description: A calf raise performed on one foot from a step with a hand on a support for balance.
instructions: Place one foot on a stable step; take support from a wall or railing for balance.
Lower the heel in a controlled way, then rise onto the toes.
Return to the start slowly and switch sides; do not bounce or let go of the balance support.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single-Leg Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Bacak Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single-Leg Dumbbell Calf Raise
description: A single-leg calf raise from a step while holding a dumbbell for added resistance.
instructions: Stand with the ball of one foot on a stable step and hold a dumbbell at your side; use a support lightly if needed for balance.
Lower your heel below the step under control, keeping your standing knee softly extended.
Press through the ball of your foot to rise onto your toes, then lower slowly; complete the set and switch sides.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
description: A floor hip extension performed on one foot with the other leg extended.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot planted on the floor; extend the other leg and keep the hips level.
Drive through the heel on the floor to lift the hips, forming a straight line from shoulder to knee.
Lower the hips under control; do not over-arch the lower back and work both sides.

alt.tr: Tek Bacak Kalça Köprüsü hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single-Leg Hip Thrust
description: A bench-supported hip extension driven by one planted leg.
instructions: Rest the upper back on a stable bench, plant one foot, and keep the other knee raised.
Drive through the planted foot to lift the hips until the torso and thigh approach a straight line.
Lower the hips under control without letting the pelvis twist; switch legs.

name: Single-Leg Leg Extension
description: A unilateral machine knee extension that works one quadriceps at a time.
instructions: Adjust the seat so the knee aligns with the machine pivot and the shin pad rests just above the ankle.
Keep your back against the seat and extend one knee until the leg is nearly straight; do not forcefully lock it.
Lower the pad slowly, finish your repetitions on that leg, then switch sides.

name: Single-Leg Leg Press
description: A unilateral leg press performed on a seated machine with one foot driving the sled.
instructions: Set the seat and safety stops, then place one foot flat near the center of the platform; keep the other leg clear of the moving sled.
Release the stops and lower the platform slowly until the working knee bends within a comfortable range without your pelvis lifting.
Press through the whole foot without locking the knee, then return under control and re-engage the stops before changing sides.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: A dumbbell hip hinge performed on one leg while the free leg extends backward.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and balance on one foot; keep the knee slightly soft.
Hinge at the hips while extending the free leg backward; keep the back neutral and the hips facing the floor.
Drive through the standing foot to return upright; you may use support for balance and should work both sides equally.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Bacak Romanya Deadlift hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single-Leg Seated Leg Curl
description: A unilateral seated machine knee curl that trains one hamstring at a time.
instructions: Adjust the seat and pads so the knee aligns with the pivot, the thigh is secured, and the lower-leg pad rests above the ankle.
Keep your hips against the seat and curl one heel down and back, bending the working knee.
Extend the working leg slowly without letting the weight stack drop; finish that side, then switch legs.

name: Sissy Squat
description: A supported knee-dominant squat variation keeping the hips extended and heels raised.
instructions: Hold a stable support lightly and stand with feet hip-width apart.
Keep your hips extended, raise your heels and let both knees travel forward as your torso leans back in one line.
Bend only as far as you can control, then straighten the knees to return.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Sissy Squat with target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Sissy Squat hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Sit-Up
description: A standard floor abdominal exercise that curls the torso upward from a bent-knee position.
instructions: Lie on a mat with knees bent and feet planted; cross your arms over your chest.
Brace your abdomen and curl your torso toward your thighs without pulling on your head.
Lower with control until your upper back returns to the mat.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Sit-Up; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Mekik hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Sled Push
description: A loaded sled is pushed forward in a low, steady walking drive.
instructions: Load a sled with a manageable weight and stand behind it with both hands on the handles.
Brace your trunk, lean forward with a long spine, and drive through short, steady steps to push the sled.
Slow down gradually at the end of the lane; reduce the load if your posture or steps become uneven.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Sled Push; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Sled İtişi hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Slider Leg Curl
description: A bridge-position leg curl in which the heels slide on sliders or towels.
instructions: Lie on your back with sliders or a towel under the heels and lift the hips into a bridge position.
With the hips staying up, drag the heels toward you and bend the knees.
Extend the legs slowly; if the lower back drops, shorten the range or lower the hips to the floor.

name: Sliding Lateral Lunge
description: A lateral lunge in which one foot slides out to the side on a sliding disc while the other leg bears the weight.
instructions: Place one foot on a sliding disc and set your feet hip-width apart; keep your torso balanced.
Slide the disc foot out to the side as you send your hips back toward the other foot; track the support knee in the direction of the foot.
Push off the support foot and pull the sliding leg back to the center; work both sides in control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the sliding lateral lunge, adductors highlighted in red.

name: Smith Machine Bench Press
description: A horizontal chest press performed on a flat bench using the guided Smith machine bar.
instructions: Set the flat bench beneath the bar so it lowers to mid-chest; use the safety stops.
Unrack the bar, lower it under control toward your chest, and keep wrists stacked over elbows.
Press upward without bouncing, then rack it securely.

name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row
description: A hinged barbell row performed on a guided Smith bar, pulling the bar toward the lower ribs.
instructions: Set the Smith bar just below knee height and load both sides evenly; stand close, grip the bar overhand, and hinge at the hips with softly bent knees and a neutral back.
Brace your torso and pull the bar toward your lower ribs, leading with your elbows while keeping your torso angle steady.
Lower the bar under control until your arms extend; keep the back neutral and re-hook the bar before changing position.

name: Smith Machine Bulgarian Split Squat
description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat performed under a guided Smith bar with the front leg doing most of the work.
instructions: Set the safety stops and place a stable bench behind you. Position the Smith bar across your upper back, not your neck; place the top of one foot on the bench and set the front foot far enough forward to keep its heel down.
Keeping most of your weight over the front foot, bend both knees and lower under control; let the front knee track in line with your toes.
Press through the front foot to return to the start. Rack the bar securely before switching legs and use a load you can control.

name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press
description: A shoulder-width Smith machine bench press that emphasizes elbow extension and the triceps.
instructions: Set a flat bench beneath the Smith bar, take a shoulder-width grip, and place the safety stops just below your comfortable bottom position.
Unrack the bar and lower it under control toward the lower chest, keeping wrists over elbows and elbows close to the torso.
Press smoothly without bouncing or forcefully locking the elbows, then rotate the bar securely into its hooks.

name: Smith Machine Deadlift
description: A low-start deadlift with coordinated knee and hip extension using the guided Smith bar.
instructions: Set the Smith bar at its lowest usable height near your lower shins and place the safety stops just below the planned bottom position; load both sides evenly and check the hooks.

Stand with the bar over midfoot, bend your hips and knees to grip it, brace, and keep your back neutral. Push through the floor and extend your knees and hips together as the bar stays close to your legs.
Stand tall without leaning back, then lower the bar along the same path under control and re-hook it securely before stepping away.

source.title: ACE Deadlift technique and Life Fitness Smith Machine documentation

name: Smith Machine Decline Bench Press
description: A decline chest press performed beneath a guided Smith bar with the feet secured at the raised end of the bench.
instructions: Set a decline bench beneath the Smith bar, secure your feet under the upper-end pads, and position the safety stops just below your comfortable bottom range.
Unrack the bar and lower it under control toward the lower chest, keeping your wrists stacked over your elbows and your shoulders on the bench.
Press the guided bar back up without bouncing or forcefully locking your elbows, then rotate it securely into its hooks.

name: Smith Machine Front Squat
description: A front-rack squat performed with the bar guided by Smith machine rails.
instructions: Set the bar near shoulder height and the safety stops at a depth you can control. Stand facing the bar and rest it across the front of your shoulders with your elbows pointing forward; rotate the bar to release the hooks.
Brace your torso and squat with your heels planted, knees tracking with your toes, and elbows lifted; descend only as far as you can keep your posture steady.
Drive through your feet to stand while keeping the bar on the front shoulders, then rotate the bar into the hooks before stepping away.

name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
description: A bench-supported hip thrust using a padded Smith bar across the hips and a guided bar path.
instructions: Place a stable bench so your upper back rests against its edge; sit under the Smith bar and position its pad across the hip crease. Set the bar low enough to begin safely and confirm the hooks engage securely.
With feet flat and knees bent, brace your trunk and drive through the floor to raise your hips until your torso and thighs align; avoid arching your lower back.
Lower the bar under control, then re-hook it securely before leaving the position.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
description: An inclined chest press performed on a bench beneath the guided Smith machine bar.
instructions: Set the bench to a modest incline beneath the bar and position the safety stops just below your comfortable bottom range.
Unrack the bar and lower it under control toward the upper chest, keeping wrists stacked over elbows.
Press up without bouncing, then rotate the bar securely back into its hooks.

name: Smith Machine Reverse Lunge
description: A reverse lunge performed under a guided Smith machine bar, returning the stepping foot to the starting stance each repetition.
instructions: Set the bar and safety stops at a suitable height; stand under the bar across your upper back and unrack it by turning the hooks clear.
Step one foot backward and lower under control until both knees bend comfortably; keep the front foot planted and front knee aligned with the toes.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, repeat on the other side, then turn the bar into the hooks securely.

name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
description: A Romanian deadlift performed with a guided Smith bar, hinging at the hips while keeping the bar close to the front of the legs.
instructions: Set the Smith bar at about hip height, load both sides evenly, and set the safety stops just below your planned range. Stand with feet hip-width and the bar against the front of your thighs.
Unlock the bar and hinge at the hips, keeping your knees softly bent, spine neutral, and bar close as it travels down the guide rails along your legs.
Stop when you feel a comfortable hamstring stretch, then press through your feet and extend your hips to stand. Re-rack the bar before changing the setup.

name: Smith Machine Shoulder Press
description: A seated overhead press with a Smith bar guided along fixed rails, using a bar path distinct from a selectorized press machine's pivoting handles.
instructions: Place an upright bench under the Smith bar. Set the bar near shoulder height and the safety stops just below the bottom of your comfortable range. Sit with your back supported, feet planted, and hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Unrack the bar and press it overhead along the rails; keep your wrists straight, elbows slightly forward, and torso against the pad without over-arching your lower back.
Lower the bar slowly to the front of your shoulders, then engage the hooks before changing the setup. Use a load you can control.

name: Smith Machine Squat
description: A guided Smith bar is set across the upper back and lowered into a controlled squat.
instructions: Set the Smith bar at upper-back height, position it across your upper back, and unlock the hooks.
With feet stable under the bar, bend your hips and knees to squat to a depth you can control while keeping your heels planted.
Drive through the floor to stand and re-engage the hooks; use the safety stops and avoid loading beyond your control.

name: Smith Machine Standing Calf Raise
description: A standing calf raise performed with the Smith machine bar across the upper back and the toes on a low platform.
instructions: Rest the Smith bar on the upper back and place the front of the feet on a low, stable platform.
Lower the heels in a controlled way to create a comfortable stretch in the calves, then rise onto the toes.
Squeeze briefly at the very top and lower the heels slowly; do not bounce.

name: Sorensen Hold
description: An isometric back-extension hold on a Roman chair with the torso held in line with the legs.
instructions: Adjust the Roman chair pad below your hip crease and secure your ankles safely under the supports.
Hold your torso in line with your legs with your arms crossed over your chest; keep your lower back neutral.
Hold this position for a short, comfortable time and come out under control; do not over-arch your lower back, and stop if you feel pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Sorensen Hold, lower back highlighted in red.

name: Spanish Squat
description: A squat in which a band behind the knees counterbalances the body so the shins stay vertical.
instructions: Place a wide, sturdy band behind the knees and anchor it securely to a fixed point.
Keep the torso upright and the heels down, then bend the knees and squat in a controlled way.
Push through the soles of the feet to stand; check that the band does not slip and release it if you feel discomfort.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Spanish Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.

name: Spider Curl
description: An EZ-bar curl performed lying face down on an incline bench so the upper arms hang straight down and the biceps stay loaded.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench; let your arms hang down and grip the EZ bar with your palms facing up.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows and raise the bar toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar under control; keep your chest supported on the bench.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Spider Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Spider Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
description: A bridge-position leg curl performed with the heels on a stability ball.
instructions: Lie on your back with the heels on a stability ball and lift the hips into a bridge position.
Pull the ball toward you with the heels and bend the knees; keep the hips up as long as you can control them.
Extend the legs slowly; if the lower back drops, reduce the range of motion.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Stability Ball Leg Curl, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Pilates Topuyla Bacak Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Stability Ball Rollout
description: A kneeling core exercise in which the forearms roll a stability ball forward while the torso stays in a straight line.
instructions: Kneel and place your forearms on the stability ball; brace your abs and keep your lower back neutral.
Keeping your torso in a straight line, roll the ball forward in a controlled way.
Return without letting your lower back sag; use only as much range as you can control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the stability ball rollout, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.

name: Standing Band Good Morning
description: A band-resisted hip hinge with the band secured beneath the feet and across the upper back.
instructions: Stand on the middle of a resistance band and place it securely across your upper back.
With knees softly bent, push your hips back and tip forward with a neutral spine.
Drive the hips forward to stand tall; use a band that allows smooth control.

name: Standing Band Hip Abduction
description: A standing exercise in which one leg is opened to the side against a band around the ankles.
instructions: Put a light band around your ankles; lightly hold onto a stable object for balance.
Keeping your torso upright, open one leg out to the side; point your toes forward.
Bring your leg back against the resistance of the band in a controlled way; do not lean your hips sideways and switch sides.

name: Standing Band Leg Curl
description: A standing knee-flexion exercise against a low anchored resistance band.
instructions: Anchor a light band low, loop it around one ankle, and hold a stable support.
Keep the thigh mostly still while bending the knee to draw the heel toward the buttock.
Lower the foot slowly against the band; repeat on the other leg.

name: Standing Band Pallof Press
description: An anti-rotation press resisting a band pulling from the side.
instructions: Anchor a band at chest height to your side and hold it at your chest.
Brace your abdomen and press both hands forward without turning.
Return slowly, then turn around to train the other side.

name: Standing Band Shoulder External Rotation
description: A light band drill rotating the forearm outward with elbow tucked.
instructions: Stand tall with elbows bent 90 degrees and close to your sides.
Rotate one forearm outward against the band without moving the elbow.
Return slowly and repeat on the other side.

name: Standing Band Shoulder Internal Rotation
description: A light resistance-band drill rotating the upper arm inward while the elbow stays tucked at the side.
instructions: Anchor a light band at elbow height and stand side-on with the working arm nearest the anchor; bend the elbow to 90 degrees and keep it against the ribs.
Rotate the forearm inward across the abdomen without turning the torso or moving the elbow.
Return slowly to the start; use light tension and stop if the shoulder feels painful.

name: Standing Bent-Knee Calf Raise

instructions: Stand near a wall for balance with knees softly bent.
Rise onto the balls of both feet while keeping the knee bend.
Pause, then lower heels slowly without bouncing.

name: Standing Cable Chest Press
description: A standing horizontal press performed with two cable handles set around mid-chest height.
instructions: Set two cable pulleys around mid-chest height. Face away from them, hold a handle in each hand, and step into a stable staggered stance with elbows bent.
Brace your torso and press both handles forward at chest height without twisting or leaning back.
Return the handles slowly until your hands are beside your chest; keep your wrists neutral and shoulders relaxed.

name: Standing Cable Hip Flexion
description: A single-leg cable drill lifting the thigh forward while the torso stays upright.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable, stand facing away and hold a support.
Brace your trunk and lift the cuffed knee forward without leaning back.
Lower slowly, finish the set and switch legs.

name: Standing Dumbbell Reverse Curl
description: A standing curl using an overhand dumbbell grip to train the forearms and elbow flexors.
instructions: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand and palms facing your thighs.
Keep wrists straight and elbows near your sides as you curl the weights upward.
Lower slowly without swinging your shoulders.

name: Standing Two-Arm Landmine Press
description: A standing diagonal press in which both hands drive the anchored end of a barbell upward and forward along the landmine arc.
instructions: Secure one end of a barbell in a landmine base. Face the anchored end, hold the free sleeve with both hands at upper-chest height, and stand with a stable hip-width stance.
Brace your trunk and press the bar diagonally forward and upward along its arc, keeping your torso tall rather than leaning back.
Bend your elbows and lower the sleeve under control to the upper chest.

name: Standing Machine Calf Raise
description: A standing calf machine moves from a lowered heel position to a controlled rise onto the toes.
instructions: Place the balls of your feet on the platform edge and stand tall with the shoulder pads resting securely across your upper shoulders.
Lower your heels below the platform within a comfortable range, then press through the balls of your feet to rise.
Pause briefly at the top and lower slowly without bouncing; adjust the machine so the pads do not shift.

name: Standing Machine Hip Thrust
description: A standing, bilateral hip extension performed against a guided machine roller positioned at the pelvis.
instructions: Follow the machine placard to set the start angle, footrests and pelvic roller. Stand on both footrests, position the roller at your pelvis and hold the handles.
Keep your knees softly bent and your trunk braced. Hinge at the hips to move your pelvis back under control without rounding your back.
Drive your hips forward against the roller until you stand tall with a neutral spine. Do not lean back; return slowly to the hinged start.

name: Standing Machine Leg Curl
description: A unilateral hamstring curl performed standing with the working thigh supported against the machine pad.
instructions: Adjust the machine so its pivot aligns with your knee and the roller rests just above your ankle; hold the support handles.
Keep your thigh against the pad and curl your heel toward your glute without swinging your hip.
Lower the weight slowly until your knee is nearly straight, keeping tension on the stack.

name: Standing Wall Calf Stretch
description: A wall-supported standing stretch for the calf of the rear leg.
instructions: Place both hands on a wall, step one foot back, and keep the back heel grounded with toes pointing forward.
Bend the front knee and lean gently toward the wall until you feel a mild stretch in the rear calf.
Hold without bouncing, then switch legs; keep the rear heel down.

name: Step-Up
description: A unilateral leg movement that lifts the body onto a stable raised surface.
instructions: Place one foot securely on a stable platform.
Push through that foot to stand on the platform, then descend.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
description: A barbell hip hinge emphasizing the hamstrings with only a small, consistent knee bend.
instructions: Stand holding the bar in front of your thighs with knees softly bent, not locked, and your spine neutral.
Push your hips back and lower the bar close to your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch you can control.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall; avoid rounding your back or leaning backward at the top.
