name: Stir the Pot
description: An advanced core-stability exercise that moves the forearms in small circles on a stability ball.
instructions: Kneel behind a stability ball and place your forearms on top; step your feet back into a steady plank.
Brace your trunk and make small, controlled circles with your forearms around the ball, keeping hips level.
Reverse the circles, then stop before your lower back arches or your shoulders lose control.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Stir the Pot; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Stir the Pot hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
description: A cable pulldown with straight arms that sweeps the bar from shoulder height down to the hips.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the high pulley; face the cable and grip the bar at shoulder width.
Keeping your elbows slightly bent and still, bring the bar down toward your hips in an arc.
Raise the bar back to shoulder height under control; do not swing your torso backward.

name: Suitcase Carry
description: A one-sided loaded carry performed while walking upright and resisting trunk side-bending.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell at your side with a firm grip and stand tall with shoulders level.
Walk a controlled distance without leaning toward or away from the weight.
Set the dumbbell down safely, switch hands, and repeat while keeping the torso upright.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Suitcase Carry; obliques highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Dambılla Yürüyüş hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; oblik kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Sumo Deadlift
description: A wide-stance barbell deadlift lifting the bar from the floor with the hands inside the knees.
instructions: Stand wide with toes slightly out and the bar over midfoot.
Hinge down and grip the bar inside your knees; brace and keep your spine neutral.
Push the floor apart and stand with the bar close, then lower it under control.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Sumo Deadlift with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Sumo Deadlift hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Sumo Squat
description: A wide-stance squat with the toes turned out that emphasizes the inner thigh muscles.
instructions: Set your feet wide apart and turn your toes comfortably outward; keep your torso upright.
As you lower your hips, let your knees track in the same direction as your toes.
Drive through the soles of your feet to stand up; do not let your knees collapse inward and stay at a pain-free depth.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the sumo squat, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Sumo Squat yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Superman
description: A prone exercise in which the opposite arm and leg are lifted slightly off the floor.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended forward; bring your forehead close to the floor and keep your neck neutral.
Without compressing your lower back, lift the opposite arm and leg slightly; keep the movement small and controlled.
Lower slowly and switch sides; if you feel discomfort in your lower back, reduce the lift height or stop.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Superman, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Superman hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Supine Medicine Ball Chest Pass
description: An explosive chest pass performed while lying on a bench, returning a light medicine ball to a partner.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet planted and hold a light medicine ball over the chest; have a partner stand clear of the ball path.
Bend the elbows to bring the ball toward the chest, then press and toss it straight upward to the partner.
Let the partner return the ball into both hands and absorb it by bending the elbows; use a light ball and a clear area.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Supine Medicine Ball Chest Pass with a partner; chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Partnerle Sırtüstü Sağlık Topu Göğüs Pası hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: T-Bar Row
description: A row with one end of a barbell anchored in a landmine sleeve and a close handle attached.
instructions: Anchor one end of the bar in a sturdy landmine sleeve and attach a suitable close handle.
Hinge forward at the hips and keep your back neutral; pull your elbows back and bring the handle toward your torso.
Lower the bar without jerking; do not rotate your torso during the pull.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the T-Bar Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: T-Bar Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Tibialis Raise
description: A wall-supported exercise that lifts the toes and forefoot toward the shins to train the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
instructions: Lean your back against a wall with the heels on the floor and the feet placed comfortably forward.
Without lifting the heels, raise the toes and forefoot toward the shins.
Lower the forefoot slowly; start with small, controlled repetitions.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Tibialis Raise, shin muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tibialis Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kaval kemiği önündeki kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Tiptoe Farmer Carry
description: A loaded carry performed high on the balls of the feet to challenge the calves.
instructions: Stand tall with a manageable dumbbell in each hand and clear walking space.
Rise onto the balls of the feet and take short controlled steps without letting the ankles roll.
Lower the heels when needed, reset balance, and continue only while the path remains clear.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the start and finish of Tiptoe Farmer Carry, with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Parmak Ucunda Farmer Carry hareketinin başlangıç ve bitişi iki gri karede gösteriliyor; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Toes-to-Bar
description: A strict hanging core exercise lifting straight legs until the toes touch the pull-up bar.
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with a firm grip and legs together.
Brace your trunk and lift your straight legs until your toes reach the bar without swinging.
Lower slowly to a controlled hang; stop if your grip becomes insecure.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Toes-to-Bar with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: Barfiks Demirine Ayak Ucu Değdirme hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Trap-Bar Deadlift
description: A deadlift performed standing inside a hex bar using neutral handles.
instructions: Stand inside the trap bar with feet about hip-width apart and the handles centered beside you.
Hinge at the hips and knees to grip the neutral handles; brace and keep your back neutral.
Push through the floor to stand tall with the bar close, then lower it under control.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Trap-Bar Deadlift with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: Trap Bar Deadlift hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
description: An elbow extension movement using a high cable attachment.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the cable and keep the elbows at the sides of the torso.
Keep the upper arms still and extend the elbows to push the bar down.
Bend the arms back to the start under control; do not let the shoulders roll forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Triceps Pushdown, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Arka Kol İtişi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Two-Dumbbell Hang Clean
description: A dumbbell power movement taking both weights from the hang position to the shoulders.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells beside your thighs and soften your knees.
Hinge slightly, then extend your hips and knees briskly to guide the dumbbells to shoulder height.
Catch the weights at your shoulders with control and lower to the hang position.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Two-Dumbbell Hang Clean with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: İki Dambılla Hang Clean hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Upright Row
description: A barbell pull from the thighs to lower-chest height with the elbows leading the movement.
instructions: Stand tall holding a light bar slightly wider than shoulder width; keep your wrists relaxed.
Pull the bar close to your body up to lower-chest height; do not raise your elbows above shoulder level.
Lower the bar slowly; if you feel pinching or pain in your shoulders, stop the movement.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Upright Row, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Dik Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: V-Squat Machine
description: A plate-loaded machine squat that follows a supported, curved arc rather than the linear path of a hack squat.
instructions: Load both sides evenly. Set your back and shoulders against the pads, place both feet securely on the platform, and follow the machine placard to release the safety.
Bend your hips and knees to lower along the machine's arc; keep your heels planted and knees tracking with your toes.
Push through the platform to stand without snapping your knees straight, then engage the safety before stepping off.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a V-Squat machine exercise; the athlete wears opaque black shorts and the hamstrings are highlighted in red.
alt.tr: V-Squat makinesi hareketinin iki gri aşaması; sporcu siyah şort giyiyor ve arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: V-Up
description: A core exercise raising the torso and straight legs together to form a V shape.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms extended overhead.
Brace your abdomen and lift your torso and legs together, reaching toward your toes.
Lower slowly without dropping the legs or arching your lower back.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of V-Up with target muscles highlighted red.
alt.tr: V-Up hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Vertical Leg Press
description: A supine leg press in which the feet drive a guided platform vertically above the hips.
instructions: Load both sides evenly. Lie back with your head, back, and hips supported; place your feet shoulder-width on the platform and release the safety only as the machine placard directs.
Bend your knees to lower the platform toward you under control, stopping at a depth that keeps your hips and lower back supported.
Press through the whole foot without snapping the knees straight; engage both safety stops before getting out.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas major-muscle expansion editorial draft

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of a supine vertical leg press, with quadriceps and glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Sırtüstü dikey leg press hareketinin iki gri aşaması; ön uyluk ve kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Waiter Curl
description: A curl in which one end of a dumbbell is held upright and supported from below by both palms to train the biceps.
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell upright by supporting one end from below with both palms; bring your elbows closer to your torso.
Keeping your elbows fixed, curl the dumbbell toward your chest under control.
Lower the weight slowly; keep your wrists comfortable and straight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Waiter Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Garson Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Walking Lunge
description: A series of forward lunges that alternates legs while moving across the floor.
instructions: Stand tall and take a balanced step forward; do not place the feet on one line.
Bend both knees under control to lower; keep the front knee over the ankle and toes.
Drive through the front foot to stand and continue with the other leg; start with in-place lunges if needed.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Walking Lunge, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yürüyerek Hamle hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Wall-Ball Shot
description: A medicine-ball front squat followed by a coordinated throw to a high wall target.
instructions: Stand facing a clear wall target, holding a light medicine ball at the upper chest with feet about shoulder-width apart.
Squat under control, then drive through the feet and hips to stand as you throw the ball toward the target.
Catch the rebound softly at chest height and descend into the next squat; begin with a light ball and clear space.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Wall-Ball Shot; quadriceps, glutes and shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Wall-Ball Atışı hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; quadriceps, kalça ve omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Wall Sit
description: An isometric squat hold with the back supported by a wall.
instructions: Stand with the back against a wall and feet a comfortable step in front.
Slide down to a comfortable seated position with knees tracking over feet.
Hold while breathing normally, then push through the feet to stand; stop if knee pain occurs.

source.title: Open Exercise Atlas illustrated muscle coverage

alt.en: Two grayscale panels show the start and finish of Wall Sit, with the target muscle highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Duvar Oturuşu hareketinin başlangıç ve bitişi iki gri karede gösteriliyor; hedef kas kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Weighted Dip
description: A dip performed between parallel bars with a secured weight plate hanging from a dip belt.
instructions: Secure a small plate to a dip belt and grip the parallel bars at the top position.
Bend your elbows to lower smoothly to a shoulder-comfortable depth while keeping the plate from swinging.
Press through the bars to return to the top; use bodyweight until you can control the full range.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Weighted Dip; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ağırlıklı Dip hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Weighted Pull-Up
description: A pull-up is performed with a securely belted weight plate hanging below the athlete.
instructions: Secure a small plate to a dip belt, grip the bar overhand slightly wider than your shoulders, and hang with arms extended.
Brace your trunk and pull your elbows down until your chin reaches bar height without swinging.
Lower under control to the full hang; start with bodyweight if you cannot maintain a smooth path.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Weighted Pull-Up; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ağırlıklı Pull-Up hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Weighted Push-Up
description: A push-up is performed in a fitted weighted vest while the body stays in a straight plank line.
instructions: Wear a fitted weighted vest and set up in a high plank with hands just wider than shoulder width.
Lower your chest toward the floor while keeping your body aligned from shoulders to heels.
Press the floor away to return to the top; use a lighter vest or a regular push-up if alignment changes.

alt.en: Two-phase grayscale illustration of Weighted Push-Up; target muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ağırlıklı Şınav hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
description: A cable pulldown with a wide overhand grip that brings the bar to the upper chest.
instructions: Secure the thigh pad and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keeping your torso upright, pull your elbows down and out to the sides; bring the bar toward your upper chest.
Do not pull the bar behind your head; extend your arms back to the start under control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Geniş Tutuşla Lat Çekiş hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
description: A dynamic low-lunge mobility sequence combining a hip-flexor stretch with controlled thoracic rotation.
instructions: Step into a long lunge and place both hands inside the front foot.
Keep the head aligned with the torso, rotate through the upper back and reach one arm upward.
Return the hand to the floor, step back and repeat on the other side.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of World's Greatest Stretch with target areas highlighted in red.
alt.tr: World’s Greatest Stretch hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef bölgeler kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Wrist Roller
description: A forearm exercise in which a rope-and-handle roller is turned with the wrists to wind a weight up and unwind it again.
instructions: Attach a light weight to the rope on a roller handle; hold the handle in front of you at shoulder height with both hands.
Turn your wrists alternately to wind the rope and slowly raise the weight.
Unwind the rope in the opposite direction under control to lower the weight; keep the load light and do not let go.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Wrist Roller, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bilek Makarası hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Yates Row
description: A hip-hinged barbell row held more upright than a near-parallel bent-over row; this entry illustrates the underhand-grip version.
instructions: Stand with feet about hip-width and grip the bar with palms facing forward. Soften your knees, hinge at the hips to a torso angle you can hold steadily, and let the bar hang below your shoulders.
Keep your torso still and the bar close as you draw your elbows back and row the bar toward your lower abdomen.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are extended comfortably, maintaining the hip hinge and straight wrists. Start with a load you can control.

source.title: Dorian Yates, Row Like the Shadow

alt.en: Two grayscale phases of an underhand Yates Row with the torso held on a moderate hip hinge; the athlete wears opaque shorts and the lats and biceps are highlighted red.
alt.tr: Gövdenin orta açılı kalça menteşesinde tutulduğu ters tutuşlu Yates Row hareketinin iki gri aşaması; sporcu kapalı şort giyiyor, lat ve biceps kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Zercher Squat
description: A barbell squat holding the bar securely in the crooks of the elbows in front of the torso.
instructions: Set the bar in a rack around lower-chest height and secure it in the crooks of your elbows.
Brace your trunk, stand with feet about shoulder-width apart and squat while keeping heels grounded.
Drive through the floor to stand; use a light load and safeties while learning the hold.

alt.en: Two-panel grayscale illustration of Zercher Squat with target areas highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Zercher Squat hareketinin iki aşamalı gri tonlu çizimi; hedef bölgeler kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Zottman Curl
description: A dumbbell curl that rotates the palms to face down at the top so the lowering phase works the forearms.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing forward; keep your elbows fixed at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up; at the top, turn your palms to face down.
Lower slowly with an overhand grip; at the bottom, turn your palms forward again.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Zottman Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Zottman Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.
